      CASE WHEN r.outstanding >= 0 THEN p_union_id::text ELSE r.club_id::text END,
      CASE WHEN r.outstanding >= 0 THEN 'club'  ELSE 'union' END,
      CASE WHEN r.outstanding >= 0 THEN r.club_id::text ELSE p_union_id::text END,
      abs(r.outstanding), abs(r.outstanding), 0,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'union_id', p_union_id, 'union_name', v_union_name,
        'club_id', r.club_id, 'club_name', r.club_name,
        'period_start', r.period_start, 'period_end', r.period_end,
        'rake_generated', r.rake_generated,
        'union_fee_kept', r.union_fee_kept,
        'rakeback_due',   r.rakeback_due,
        'players_won',    r.players_won,
        'player_pnl_net', r.player_pnl_net,
        'eco_amount',     r.eco_amount,
        'eco_enabled',    r.eco_enabled,
        'presettled',     r.presettled,
        'settled_in_chips', r.settled_in_chips,
        'outstanding',    r.outstanding,
        'net_position',   r.net_position,
        'direction',      r.direction,
        'baseline_cash_exact', v_basis_exact,
        'computed_at',    now())||v_components,
      'generated', false, v_due,
      'Weekly union square-up. Settled in chips is the Monday rakeback the union paid the club '
      || 'plus the player result excluding fees, which was already settled at the tables and is not '
      || 'a union or club transfer; neither part is billed again. Outstanding (ECO plus recorded '
      || 'presettlements) is what remains to settle.'
      || CASE WHEN v_components ? 'weekly_player_results' THEN
       E'\nCash Player Net Loss: '||(v_components#>>'{weekly_player_results,cash_net_loss}')
       ||E'\nTournament Player Net Loss: '||(v_components#>>'{weekly_player_results,tournament_net_loss}')
       ||E'\nTotal Player Net Loss: '||(v_components#>>'{weekly_player_results,total_net_loss}')
       ||E'\nLess Club Rakeback Credit: '||(v_components#>>'{weekly_player_results,rakeback_credit}')
       ||E'\nECO Charge Or Credit: '||(v_components#>>'{weekly_player_results,eco_charge}')
       ||E'\nFull Weekly Net (Positive Club Owes Union): '||(v_components#>>'{weekly_player_results,weekly_net_due_to_union}')
       ||E'\nRemaining External Balance (Positive Union Owes Club): '||r.outstanding::text
       ||E'\nThe Full Weekly Net Is A Summary, Not An Additional Payment Request.'
       ELSE '' END)
    ON CONFLICT (club_id, period_id, invoice_type)
      WHERE invoice_type = 'union_weekly_squareup'
    DO UPDATE SET
      from_entity_type = EXCLUDED.from_entity_type,
      from_entity_id   = EXCLUDED.from_entity_id,
      to_entity_type   = EXCLUDED.to_entity_type,
      to_entity_id     = EXCLUDED.to_entity_id,
      gross_amount     = EXCLUDED.gross_amount,
      net_amount       = EXCLUDED.net_amount,
      invoice_number   = COALESCE(settlement_invoices.invoice_number, EXCLUDED.invoice_number),
      breakdown        = EXCLUDED.breakdown,
      due_at           = EXCLUDED.due_at,
      updated_at       = now()
    WHERE COALESCE(settlement_invoices.message_sent, false) = false AND settlement_invoices.status NOT IN('paid','cancelled')
    RETURNING id, COALESCE(message_sent, false) INTO v_invoice_id, v_already_sent;

    -- The upsert returns nothing when the guard above refused to restate an
    -- already-delivered invoice. That row is the record; read it as it stands.
    IF v_invoice_id IS NULL THEN
      SELECT si.id, COALESCE(si.message_sent, false)
        INTO v_invoice_id, v_already_sent
        FROM settlement_invoices si
       WHERE si.club_id = r.club_id
         AND si.period_id = v_period_id
         AND si.invoice_type = 'union_weekly_squareup';
    END IF;

    v_issued := v_issued + 1;

    -- Delivery is mandatory and shared with every accounting invoice.
    v_msg := public.fn_deliver_accounting_invoice(v_invoice_id);
    v_notified := v_notified + CASE WHEN v_already_sent THEN (v_msg->>'new_deliveries')::int ELSE (v_msg->>'delivered')::int END;
    v_messaged := v_messaged + CASE WHEN v_already_sent THEN (v_msg->>'new_deliveries')::int ELSE (v_msg->>'delivered')::int END;

    v_out := v_out || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'club_id', r.club_id, 'club_name', r.club_name,
      'invoice_id', v_invoice_id, 'outstanding', r.outstanding,
      'direction', r.direction, 'due_at', v_due,
      'messaged', COALESCE((v_msg->>'delivered')::int, 0),
      'already_sent', v_already_sent));
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'union_id', p_union_id,
    'period_start', v_from, 'period_end', v_to, 'due_at', v_due,
    'baseline_cash_exact', v_basis_exact,
    'invoices', v_issued, 'notified', v_notified, 'messenger_deliveries', v_messaged,
    'detail', v_out);
END;
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_boundary(p_union_id.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_boundary(p_union_id uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE inv jsonb; holdings jsonb:='[]'; issues jsonb:='[]'; s jsonb; t jsonb; f record; tr record;
 lineage jsonb; owned uuid; owners int; initial int; value numeric; entries int; first_op text;
 nonchips boolean; changed boolean; returned numeric; res_club uuid; res_amount numeric; v_proj boolean;
 seat_rows int; seat_value numeric; seat_club uuid; seat_credits int; original_receivables jsonb;
 seat_credit_total numeric;
BEGIN
 inv:=public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_as_of_admitted(p_at);
 IF inv->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'observed' THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','inventory',inv,'holdings',holdings); END IF;
 FOR s IN SELECT x->'row' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(inv#>'{population,table_seats}','[]')) x
  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(inv#>'{population,tables}','[]')) y
   WHERE y#>>'{row,id}'=x#>>'{row,table_id}' AND y#>>'{row,union_id}'=p_union_id::text) LOOP
  lineage:=public.fn_cash_original_funding_lineage((s->>'user_id')::uuid,(s->>'table_id')::uuid,
   (s->>'id')::uuid,(s->>'occupancy_id')::uuid,(s->>'joined_at')::timestamptz,p_at,true);
  SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE smarter_private.cash_initial_funding_receipt(r.id) IS TRUE),count(DISTINCT (r.funding_club_id,r.funding_union_id,r.asset)),min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid
   INTO initial,owners,owned FROM jsonb_array_elements(lineage->'funding_receipts') ref
   JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.id=(ref->>'id')::uuid;
  value:=public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(s->'stack');
  IF lineage->'issues'<>'[]'::jsonb OR initial<>1 OR owners<>1 OR owned IS NULL OR value IS NULL OR value<0 THEN
   issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','cash_boundary_original_funding_missing_or_ambiguous','seat_id',s->'id'));
  ELSE
   holdings:=holdings||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('club_id',owned,'user_id',s->'user_id','amount',value,'kind','cash_stack','source_id',s->'id'));
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Money awaiting the original add-on application is still held for its
 -- original funding account. It must not appear as a poker loss at midnight.
 FOR f IN
  SELECT r.*,r.amount-CASE WHEN COALESCE(af.observed_at,a.applied_at)<p_at THEN a.applied+a.refunded ELSE 0 END AS held
  FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r
  LEFT JOIN public.cash_funding_application_receipts a ON a.funding_receipt_id=r.id
  LEFT JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames rf ON rf.transaction_id=r.transaction_id
  LEFT JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames af ON af.transaction_id=a.transaction_id
  WHERE r.pending_addon_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(rf.observed_at,r.recorded_at)<p_at
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(inv#>'{population,tables}','[]')) y
    WHERE y#>>'{row,id}'=r.table_id::text AND y#>>'{row,union_id}'=p_union_id::text)
 LOOP
  IF f.held<0 OR f.funding_club_id IS NULL THEN
   issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','pending_funding_boundary_invalid','source_id',f.id));
  ELSIF f.held>0 THEN
   holdings:=holdings||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('club_id',f.funding_club_id,'user_id',f.user_id,'amount',f.held,'kind','pending_cash_funding','source_id',f.id));
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Preserve the established realized-settlement rule: original gross entry
 -- less money already returned is deferred while a tournament remains open.
 -- This is not market value, ICM, or a new allocation of the prize pool.
 -- First inventory operations come from union_pnl_inventory_touches once its
 -- backfill is complete (20260929044303), else from the wide events.
 v_proj:=public.fn_union_pnl_projection_ready('inventory_touches');
 FOR t IN SELECT x->'row' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(inv#>'{population,tournaments}','[]')) x
  WHERE x#>>'{row,union_id}'=p_union_id::text LOOP
  first_op:=public.fn_union_pnl_first_inventory_operation('tournaments',(t->>'id')::uuid,v_proj);
  -- A tournament captured as the baseline (it existed before the original
  -- inventory capture) is read only when every registration of its original
  -- population carries a valid opening resolution for this boundary
  -- (union_pnl_opening_registration_resolutions: its entry re-proved from the
  -- posted chip ledger, bound to these exact population rows). Otherwise it is
  -- refused exactly as before.
  IF first_op IS DISTINCT FROM 'INSERT' AND (first_op IS DISTINCT FROM 'baseline' OR EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(inv#>'{population,tournament_players}','[]')) y(x)
    WHERE y.x#>>'{row,tournament_id}'=t->>'id'
     AND public.fn_union_pnl_first_inventory_operation('tournament_players',(y.x#>>'{row,id}')::uuid,v_proj) IS DISTINCT FROM 'INSERT'
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.fn_union_pnl_opening_registration_resolution(p_union_id,p_at,t,y.x->'row')))) THEN
   issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','open_tournament_precedes_original_population','tournament_id',t->'id')); CONTINUE;
  END IF;
  -- One set-based read per open tournament (it was four queries per seat,
  -- two of them full scans of every tournament credit): the same original
  -- entry, instrument, owner-change and returned-credit facts, per
  -- registration, in the population's order.
  FOR s,entries,owners,owned,value,nonchips,changed,returned,res_club,res_amount IN
   WITH players AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT y.x->'row' s,y.o ord,(y.x#>>'{row,id}')::uuid registration_id,(y.x#>>'{row,user_id}')::uuid user_id
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(inv#>'{population,tournament_players}','[]')) WITH ORDINALITY y(x,o)
    WHERE y.x#>>'{row,tournament_id}'=t->>'id'
   ), credits AS MATERIALIZED (
    -- fn_union_pnl_tournament_returns(t,NULL,NULL,p_at): every credit of this
    -- tournament observed before the boundary; the registration filter that
    -- function applied per call is applied per player below.
    SELECT c.user_id,c.credited_club_id,c.amount,c.entry_receipt_ids,true same_tournament
    FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c
    JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=c.transaction_id
    WHERE c.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND b.observed_at<p_at
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r2.user_id,r2.source_wallet_club_id,r2.amount_paid_now,ARRAY[r.id],false
    FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches r2
    JOIN public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.entitlement_id=r2.entitlement_id
    JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=r2.transaction_id
    WHERE r2.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND b.observed_at<p_at
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c WHERE c.ledger_id=r2.credit_ledger_id)
   ) SELECT p.s,e.entries,e.owners,e.owned,e.value,
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r WHERE r.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND r.registration_id=p.registration_id AND r.asset<>'chips'),
    k.changed,k.returned,rr.owning_club_id,rr.deferred_amount
   FROM players p
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) entries,count(DISTINCT public.fn_union_pnl_tournament_entry_club_of(r.asset,r.amount,r.funding_club_id,r.ledger_id,r.entitlement_id,r.registration_snapshot)) owners,
     min(public.fn_union_pnl_tournament_entry_club_of(r.asset,r.amount,r.funding_club_id,r.ledger_id,r.entitlement_id,r.registration_snapshot)::text)::uuid owned,sum(r.amount) value
    FROM public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r
    JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=r.transaction_id
    WHERE r.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND r.registration_id=p.registration_id AND b.observed_at<p_at AND r.asset='chips') e
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(c.credited_club_id<>e.owned),false) changed,sum(c.amount) returned
    FROM credits c WHERE c.user_id=p.user_id
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r
      WHERE r.registration_id=p.registration_id AND r.id=ANY(c.entry_receipt_ids)
       AND (NOT c.same_tournament OR r.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid))) k
   LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT q.owning_club_id,q.deferred_amount
    FROM public.fn_union_pnl_opening_registration_resolution(p_union_id,p_at,t,p.s) q WHERE first_op='baseline') rr ON true
   ORDER BY p.ord
  LOOP
   -- In a baseline tournament a resolved registration is carried at its
   -- re-proved original entry less its returns before the boundary.
   IF res_club IS NOT NULL THEN
    holdings:=holdings||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('club_id',res_club,'user_id',s->'user_id','amount',res_amount,
     'kind','deferred_tournament_result','source_id',s->'id','basis','opening_registration_resolution'));
    CONTINUE;
   END IF;
   -- A satellite-won seat (20261007001000) has no entry receipt: it was
   -- never charged to a wallet. It is held at the value its one funding row
   -- moved into this prize liability, for the club that funded the seat.
   IF entries=0 AND NOT nonchips AND s->>'source_satellite_id' IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT count(*),sum(l.amount) INTO seat_rows,seat_value FROM public.chip_ledger l
     WHERE l.status='posted' AND l.row_hash IS NOT NULL AND l.created_at<p_at
      AND l.to_type='prize_liability' AND l.to_entity_id=(t->>'id')::uuid
      AND l.metadata->>'registration_id'=s->>'id' AND l.metadata->>'user_id'=s->>'user_id'
      AND ((l.category='tournament_buyin' AND l.from_type='prize_liability' AND l.from_entity_id=(s->>'source_satellite_id')::uuid
        AND l.metadata->>'kind'='satellite_seat_pool_transfer')
       OR (l.category='ticket_redeem' AND l.from_type='escrow' AND l.metadata->>'kind'='tournament_entry_ticket_admission'
        AND l.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=s->>'source_satellite_id'));
    seat_club:=public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner((s->>'id')::uuid,(t->>'id')::uuid);
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c
      JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=c.transaction_id
      WHERE c.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND c.user_id::text=s->>'user_id' AND b.observed_at<p_at)
     +(SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches r2
      JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=r2.transaction_id
      WHERE r2.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND r2.user_id::text=s->>'user_id' AND b.observed_at<p_at)
     INTO seat_credits;
    IF seat_rows=1 AND seat_value>0 AND seat_club IS NOT NULL AND seat_credits=0 THEN
     holdings:=holdings||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('club_id',seat_club,'user_id',s->'user_id','amount',seat_value,
      'kind','deferred_tournament_result','source_id',s->'id','basis','satellite_seat'));
     CONTINUE;
    END IF;
   END IF;
   IF entries=0 OR owners<>1 OR owned IS NULL OR nonchips THEN
    issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','open_tournament_original_instrument_or_earning_club_missing','registration_id',s->'id')); CONTINUE;
   END IF;
   IF changed THEN
    issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','open_tournament_credit_owner_changed','registration_id',s->'id')); CONTINUE;
   END IF;
   value:=value-COALESCE(returned,0);
   -- A SATELLITE SEAT HELD WITH RE-ENTRIES (20261114182834): a registration
   -- admitted by a satellite-won seat that ALSO bought chips (a re-entry or a
   -- rebuy) has entry receipts, so it never reaches the seat-only branch
   -- above, and the seat's value was left out of its holding. At the
   -- 2026-11-02 boundary six such registrations held 405.00 of seats and the
   -- week's opening read 405.00 short. The seat is held here at the value its
   -- one funding row moved into this prize liability, for the club that
   -- funded the seat, exactly as the seat-only branch holds it. No seat row:
   -- nothing moved into the pool before the boundary, nothing to hold. More
   -- than one, a non-positive value, no seat owner, or a credit to this
   -- player in this tournament not attributed to this registration's entries
   -- is refused, never guessed.
   IF s->>'source_satellite_id' IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT count(*),sum(l.amount) INTO seat_rows,seat_value FROM public.chip_ledger l
     WHERE l.status='posted' AND l.row_hash IS NOT NULL AND l.created_at<p_at
      AND l.to_type='prize_liability' AND l.to_entity_id=(t->>'id')::uuid
      AND l.metadata->>'registration_id'=s->>'id' AND l.metadata->>'user_id'=s->>'user_id'
      AND ((l.category='tournament_buyin' AND l.from_type='prize_liability' AND l.from_entity_id=(s->>'source_satellite_id')::uuid
        AND l.metadata->>'kind'='satellite_seat_pool_transfer')
       OR (l.category='ticket_redeem' AND l.from_type='escrow' AND l.metadata->>'kind'='tournament_entry_ticket_admission'
        AND l.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=s->>'source_satellite_id'));
    IF seat_rows>0 THEN
     seat_club:=public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner((s->>'id')::uuid,(t->>'id')::uuid);
     SELECT COALESCE((SELECT sum(c.amount) FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c
       JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=c.transaction_id
       WHERE c.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND c.user_id::text=s->>'user_id' AND b.observed_at<p_at),0)
      +COALESCE((SELECT sum(r2.amount_paid_now) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches r2
       JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=r2.transaction_id
       WHERE r2.tournament_id=(t->>'id')::uuid AND r2.user_id::text=s->>'user_id' AND b.observed_at<p_at
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c WHERE c.ledger_id=r2.credit_ledger_id)),0)
      INTO seat_credit_total;
     IF seat_rows<>1 OR seat_value IS NULL OR seat_value<=0 OR seat_club IS NULL
        OR seat_credit_total IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(returned,0) THEN
      issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','open_tournament_satellite_seat_with_entries_unproven','registration_id',s->'id')); CONTINUE;
     END IF;
     holdings:=holdings||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('club_id',seat_club,'user_id',s->'user_id','amount',seat_value,
      'kind','deferred_tournament_result','source_id',s->'id','basis','satellite_seat'));
    END IF;
   END IF;
   holdings:=holdings||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('club_id',owned,'user_id',s->'user_id','amount',value,'kind','deferred_tournament_result','source_id',s->'id'));
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 IF p_union_id='fade0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid AND p_at>='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz THEN
  original_receivables:=smarter_private.original_erased_cash_receivables(p_union_id,p_at);
  IF original_receivables->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' THEN
   issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','original_erased_receivable_unproven','evidence',original_receivables));
  ELSE
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(holdings) existing JOIN jsonb_array_elements(original_receivables->'holdings') owed
    ON existing->>'source_id'=owed->>'source_id') THEN
    issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','original_erased_receivable_double_count_refused'));
   ELSE holdings:=holdings||(original_receivables->'holdings');END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status',CASE WHEN issues='[]'::jsonb THEN 'ready' ELSE 'blocked' END,'boundary',p_at,
  'inventory',inv,'holdings',holdings,'issues',issues,'tournament_basis','original_realized_settlement_deferred_while_open');
END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_cash_outcome_touch().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_cash_outcome_touch()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_touches
 SELECT * FROM public.fn_union_pnl_cash_outcome_touch_row(NEW.table_id,NEW.hand_number,NEW.recognized_at,NEW.game_scope,NEW.evidence)
 ON CONFLICT (table_id,hand_number) DO NOTHING;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_cash_outcome_touch_r.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_cash_outcome_touch_row(p_table_id uuid, p_hand_number bigint, p_recognized_at timestamp with time zone, p_game_scope jsonb, p_evidence jsonb)
 RETURNS SETOF union_pnl_cash_outcome_touches
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT p_table_id,p_hand_number,p_recognized_at,p_game_scope->>'game_union_id',
  (p_evidence->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' OR p_evidence->'basis_certified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
   OR p_evidence->'all_players_included' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR p_evidence->'game_scope' IS DISTINCT FROM p_game_scope),
  p_evidence->>'accepted_rake',public.fn_union_pnl_compact_participants(p_evidence->'participants')
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_close_quality(p_unio.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_close_quality(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE evidence jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_union_id IS NULL OR p_start IS NULL OR p_end IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_start) OR NOT isfinite(p_end)
  OR p_start<'2026-09-07 07:00:00+00'::timestamptz OR p_end<=p_start OR p_end>statement_timestamp()
  OR p_end-p_start>interval '8 days' THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','pnl_requires_closed_supported_period','issues',jsonb_build_array('invalid_pnl_evidence_period'));
 END IF;
 evidence:=public.fn_union_pnl_evidence_report(p_union_id,p_start,p_end);
 IF evidence->'report_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb
  OR evidence->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' OR evidence->'basis_certified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR evidence->'issues' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb THEN
  -- No player identities, source amounts, balances or invoice contents cross
  -- this gate. Callers retain their original authorization before evaluation.
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','union_pnl_basis_uncertified',
   'issues',CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(evidence->'issues')='array' THEN evidence->'issues'
    ELSE jsonb_build_array('pnl_evidence_contract_missing') END);
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','ready','issues','[]'::jsonb);
END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_compact_participants.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_compact_participants(p_participants jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_participants)='array' THEN
   (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('earning_club_id',e.x->'earning_club_id','user_id',e.x->'user_id',
      'observed_stack_delta',e.x->'observed_stack_delta') ORDER BY e.n),'[]'::jsonb)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_participants) WITH ORDINALITY e(x,n))
  ELSE p_participants END
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_as_of_admi.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_as_of_admitted(p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
AS $function$
DECLARE raw jsonb; remaining jsonb; admitted jsonb;n integer;unique_n integer;h record;current_header record;
BEGIN
 IF p_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_at) OR p_at<>public.fn_union_week_start(p_at) OR p_at>clock_timestamp() THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','closed_original_week_boundary_required');END IF;
 raw:=public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_as_of(p_at);
 -- Missing coverage or an unknown original result is never an empty issue list.
 IF raw IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(raw) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR raw->>'status' NOT IN('observed','blocked') OR raw->>'status' IS NULL
 OR jsonb_typeof(raw->'issues') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(raw->'population') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR (raw->>'status'='blocked' AND raw->'issues'='[]'::jsonb)
 OR (raw->>'status'='observed' AND raw->'issues'<>'[]'::jsonb)
 OR raw ? 'reason'
 OR raw->'inventory_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb
 OR raw->'current_state_used' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
 OR raw->'financial_basis_certified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
 OR (raw->>'boundary')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM p_at
 OR nullif(raw->>'capture_started_at','') IS NULL
 OR raw->>'coverage' IS DISTINCT FROM 'Original active population and later captured transitions; monetary funding and obligation receipts must independently certify equity.' THEN
  RETURN (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(raw)='object' THEN raw ELSE '{}'::jsonb END)||jsonb_build_object('status','blocked',
   'admission_status','original_inventory_shape_unproven','financial_basis_certified',false);
 END IF;
 -- A duplicate issue tuple is never two independent original authorities.
 SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT jsonb_build_array(x->>'source_name',x->>'row_id',x->>'source_event_id'))
 INTO n,unique_n FROM jsonb_array_elements(raw->'issues')x;
 IF n IS DISTINCT FROM unique_n THEN RETURN raw||jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','admission_status','duplicate_original_issue_refused');END IF;
 -- Verify the active raw projection against its immutable original sealed
 -- header. This also rejects a forged warm temp-cache population.
 IF p_at>='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz THEN
 SELECT * INTO current_header FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_checkpoints WHERE boundary=p_at;
 IF NOT FOUND OR current_header.result_md5 IS NULL
 OR md5(jsonb_build_object('population',raw->'population','issues',raw->'issues')::text) IS DISTINCT FROM current_header.result_md5
 OR (p_at='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND current_header.result_md5 IS DISTINCT FROM 'dd5e733acc7ed72e69b98d009ac124a6') THEN
 RETURN raw||jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','admission_status','raw_sealed_projection_or_cache_refused');END IF;END IF;
 -- Observed original results require no admission and are returned byte-identical.
 IF raw->>'status'='observed' THEN RETURN raw;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO h FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_checkpoints WHERE boundary='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz;
 IF NOT FOUND OR p_at<'2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz
 OR h.base_boundary IS DISTINCT FROM '2026-10-05 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz
 OR h.max_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM 63116879::bigint OR h.row_count IS DISTINCT FROM 3352453::bigint
 OR h.issue_count IS DISTINCT FROM 245::bigint OR n>245
 OR (p_at='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND n IS DISTINCT FROM 245)
 OR h.rows_md5 IS DISTINCT FROM '5ae24d37326afb43bf598385c2ce24c5'
 OR h.issues_md5 IS DISTINCT FROM '9492245970312d6ac027287a5126c114'
 OR h.result_md5 IS DISTINCT FROM 'dd5e733acc7ed72e69b98d009ac124a6'
 OR h.sealed_at IS DISTINCT FROM '2026-10-12 11:40:53.278694Z'::timestamptz
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM smarter_private.original_inventory_restoration_cases) IS DISTINCT FROM 245::bigint
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM smarter_private.original_inventory_restoration_certificates WHERE boundary='2026-10-12 07:00:00Z'::timestamptz) IS DISTINCT FROM 245::bigint
 THEN RETURN raw||jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','admission_status','exact_original_sealed_coverage_refused');END IF;
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(i.issue ORDER BY i.ord) FILTER(WHERE NOT i.accepted),'[]'::jsonb),
        COALESCE(jsonb_agg(i.issue ORDER BY i.ord) FILTER(WHERE i.accepted),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO remaining,admitted
 FROM(SELECT x.issue,x.ord,
   smarter_private.inventory_restoration_issue_accepted(x.issue,p_at) IS TRUE accepted
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(raw->'issues') WITH ORDINALITY x(issue,ord)) i;
 RETURN raw||jsonb_build_object(
  'status',CASE WHEN remaining='[]'::jsonb THEN 'observed' ELSE 'blocked' END,
  'issues',remaining,'retained_original_inventory_issues',raw->'issues',
  'admitted_original_inventory_issues',admitted,
  'raw_inventory_as_of_result_md5',md5(raw::text),'raw_inventory_status',raw->>'status',
  'admission_basis','Exact immutable original restoration boundary certificates; original population untouched',
  'financial_basis_certified',false);
END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_build_popu.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_build_population(p_base timestamp with time zone, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE population jsonb; gaps jsonb;
BEGIN
 WITH s AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_build_state(p_base,p_at)
 ), current_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.o_source_name source_name,s.o_row_id row_id,s.o_event_id event_id,s.o_after_row after_row,s.o_first_operation first_operation
  FROM s WHERE s.o_kind='row' AND s.o_after_row IS NOT NULL
 ), active AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM current_rows r WHERE source_name='union_clubs'
   OR (source_name='tables' AND after_row->'tournament_id'='null'::jsonb)
   OR (source_name='table_seats' AND after_row->'left_at'='null'::jsonb)
   OR (source_name='tournaments' AND after_row->>'status' NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'))
   OR (source_name='tournament_players' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM current_rows t WHERE t.source_name='tournaments'
    AND t.row_id::text=r.after_row->>'tournament_id' AND t.after_row->>'status' NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED')))
 ), grouped AS (
  SELECT source_name,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_event_id',event_id,'row',after_row) ORDER BY row_id) rows FROM active GROUP BY source_name
 ) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(source_name,rows) FROM grouped),'{}'),
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_name',source_name,'row_id',row_id,'reason','active_row_original_population_missing') ORDER BY source_name,row_id)
   FROM active WHERE first_operation NOT IN ('baseline','INSERT')
    -- A seat vacated before capture began and re-opened afterwards: its first
    -- captured event is the UPDATE that opened this occupancy (see 20260928153000).
    AND NOT (source_name='table_seats' AND first_operation='UPDATE' AND EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT e.before_row FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
       WHERE e.source_name='table_seats' AND e.row_id=active.row_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 1) f
     WHERE f.before_row->>'left_at' IS NOT NULL
      AND (f.before_row->>'left_at')::timestamptz<=(SELECT c.captured_at FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_capture c WHERE c.singleton)))),'[]')
  ||COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_name',s.o_source_name,'row_id',s.o_row_id,'source_event_id',s.o_event_id,'reason','original_inventory_chain_disagrees') ORDER BY s.o_source_name,s.o_row_id,s.o_event_id)
   FROM s WHERE s.o_kind='issue'),'[]') INTO population,gaps;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('population',population,'issues',gaps);
END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_build_stat.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_build_state(p_base timestamp with time zone, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(o_kind text, o_source_name text, o_row_id uuid, o_event_id bigint, o_first_operation text, o_after_row jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_base IS DISTINCT FROM p_at OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_seal_builds b WHERE b.boundary=p_at AND b.ready) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete_inventory_build_required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT 'row'::text,r.source_name,r.row_id,r.latest_event_id,r.first_operation,r.after_row
  FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_seal_build_rows r WHERE r.boundary=p_at
 UNION ALL SELECT 'issue',i.source_name,i.row_id,i.event_id,NULL::text,NULL::jsonb
  FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_seal_build_issues i WHERE i.boundary=p_at;
END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_build_tran.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_build_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.ready=false AND NEW.ready=false
  AND NEW.last_kind IS NOT NULL
  AND (OLD.last_kind IS NULL OR (NEW.last_kind,NEW.last_source,NEW.last_row,NEW.last_event)>(OLD.last_kind,OLD.last_source,OLD.last_row,OLD.last_event))
  AND (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['last_kind','last_source','last_row','last_event'])=(to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['last_kind','last_source','last_row','last_event'])
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_checkpoints c WHERE c.boundary=OLD.boundary) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.ready=false AND NEW.ready=true
  AND (to_jsonb(OLD)-'ready')=(to_jsonb(NEW)-'ready')
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_checkpoints c WHERE c.boundary=OLD.boundary) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory_build_is_immutable' USING ERRCODE='55000';
END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_layer_stat.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_layer_state(p_week_base timestamp with time zone, p_boundary timestamp with time zone, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(o_kind text, o_source_name text, o_row_id uuid, o_event_id bigint, o_first_operation text, o_after_row jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET work_mem TO '64MB'
 SET enable_indexscan TO 'off'
 SET max_parallel_workers_per_gather TO '0'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- fn_union_pnl_inventory_state over the events of [p_from, p_to), its base
 -- being the snapshot at p_from: the latest staged layer (of this boundary,
 -- ending by p_from) that touched a row, else the week's base checkpoint row.
 -- Only the rows this layer touches are returned, each with its complete
 -- issue set as fn_union_pnl_inventory_state would return it.
 IF p_to IS NULL OR p_from IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_to) OR NOT isfinite(p_from) OR p_from>=p_to OR p_boundary IS NULL OR p_to>p_boundary
  OR (p_week_base IS NOT NULL AND p_week_base>p_from) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_inventory_layer_window' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH d AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.source_name sn,e.row_id rid,e.event_id eid,e.operation op,
   jsonb_hash_extended(e.before_row,0) b0,jsonb_hash_extended(e.before_row,1) b1,
   jsonb_hash_extended(e.after_row,0) a0,jsonb_hash_extended(e.after_row,1) a1
  FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
  WHERE e.observed_at>=p_from AND e.observed_at<p_to
 ), t AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.sn,d.rid,min(d.eid) min_id,max(d.eid) max_id FROM d GROUP BY d.sn,d.rid
 ), b AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.sn,t.rid) t.sn,t.rid,s.src,s.layer,s.eid,s.fop,s.after_row,
   jsonb_hash_extended(s.after_row,0) a0,jsonb_hash_extended(s.after_row,1) a1
  FROM t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT 'layer'::text src,l.layer_end layer,l.latest_event_id eid,l.first_operation fop,l.after_row
    FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_seal_layer_rows l
    WHERE l.boundary=p_boundary AND l.source_name=t.sn AND l.row_id=t.rid AND l.layer_end<=p_from
   UNION ALL
   SELECT 'base',NULL::timestamptz,r.latest_event_id,r.first_operation,r.after_row
    FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_published_rows r
    WHERE r.boundary=p_week_base AND r.source_name=t.sn AND r.row_id=t.rid) s
  ORDER BY t.sn,t.rid,s.layer DESC NULLS LAST
 ), x AS MATERIALIZED (
  -- A delta event ordered (by event_id) before the row's last earlier event:
  -- that row's whole chain is re-read below instead of continued.
  SELECT t.sn,t.rid FROM t JOIN b ON b.sn=t.sn AND b.rid=t.rid WHERE t.min_id<b.eid
 ), w AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.sn,d.rid,d.eid,d.b0,d.b1,
   row_number() OVER p k,lag(d.a0) OVER p pa0,lag(d.a1) OVER p pa1,first_value(d.op) OVER p fop
  FROM d WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM x WHERE x.sn=d.sn AND x.rid=d.rid)
  WINDOW p AS (PARTITION BY d.sn,d.rid ORDER BY d.eid)
 ), tl AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.event_id eid,e.after_row FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
  WHERE e.event_id=ANY(ARRAY(SELECT t.max_id FROM t WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM x WHERE x.sn=t.sn AND x.rid=t.rid)))
 ), xh AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.sn,e.rid,e.eid,e.before_row,e.after_row,
   row_number() OVER p k,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY e.sn,e.rid ORDER BY e.eid DESC) latest,
   lag(e.after_row) OVER p prior_after,first_value(e.op) OVER p fop
  FROM x CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT h.source_name sn,h.row_id rid,h.event_id eid,h.operation op,h.before_row,h.after_row
   FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events h WHERE h.source_name=x.sn AND h.row_id=x.rid AND h.observed_at<p_to) e
  WINDOW p AS (PARTITION BY e.sn,e.rid ORDER BY e.eid)
 ), pi AS MATERIALIZED (
  -- The issue set each touched row had at p_from: its latest layer's, else
  -- the base checkpoint's.
  SELECT li.source_name sn,li.row_id rid,li.event_id eid FROM b JOIN public.union_pnl_inventory_seal_layer_issues li
   ON b.src='layer' AND li.boundary=p_boundary AND li.layer_end=b.layer AND li.source_name=b.sn AND li.row_id=b.rid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ci.source_name,ci.row_id,ci.event_id FROM t JOIN public.union_pnl_inventory_published_issues ci
   ON ci.boundary=p_week_base AND ci.source_name=t.sn AND ci.row_id=t.rid
  WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b WHERE b.sn=t.sn AND b.rid=t.rid AND b.src='layer')
 )
 SELECT 'row'::text,t.sn,t.rid,t.max_id,COALESCE(b.fop,w.fop),tl.after_row
  FROM t JOIN w ON w.sn=t.sn AND w.rid=t.rid AND w.k=1
  JOIN tl ON tl.eid=t.max_id
  LEFT JOIN b ON b.sn=t.sn AND b.rid=t.rid
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'row',xh.sn,xh.rid,xh.eid,xh.fop,xh.after_row FROM xh WHERE xh.latest=1
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'issue',pi.sn,pi.rid,pi.eid,NULL::text,NULL::jsonb FROM pi WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM x WHERE x.sn=pi.sn AND x.rid=pi.rid)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'issue',w.sn,w.rid,w.eid,NULL,NULL FROM w WHERE w.k>1 AND (w.pa0,w.pa1) IS DISTINCT FROM (w.b0,w.b1)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'issue',w.sn,w.rid,w.eid,NULL,NULL FROM w JOIN b ON b.sn=w.sn AND b.rid=w.rid
  WHERE w.k=1 AND (b.a0,b.a1) IS DISTINCT FROM (w.b0,w.b1)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'issue',xh.sn,xh.rid,xh.eid,NULL,NULL FROM xh WHERE xh.k>1 AND xh.prior_after IS DISTINCT FROM xh.before_row;
END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_population.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_population(p_base timestamp with time zone, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE population jsonb; gaps jsonb;
BEGIN
 WITH s AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_state(p_base,p_at)
 ), current_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.o_source_name source_name,s.o_row_id row_id,s.o_event_id event_id,s.o_after_row after_row,s.o_first_operation first_operation
  FROM s WHERE s.o_kind='row' AND s.o_after_row IS NOT NULL
 ), active AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM current_rows r WHERE source_name='union_clubs'
   OR (source_name='tables' AND after_row->'tournament_id'='null'::jsonb)
   OR (source_name='table_seats' AND after_row->'left_at'='null'::jsonb)
   OR (source_name='tournaments' AND after_row->>'status' NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED'))
   OR (source_name='tournament_players' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM current_rows t WHERE t.source_name='tournaments'
    AND t.row_id::text=r.after_row->>'tournament_id' AND t.after_row->>'status' NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED')))
 ), grouped AS (
  SELECT source_name,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_event_id',event_id,'row',after_row) ORDER BY row_id) rows FROM active GROUP BY source_name
 ) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(source_name,rows) FROM grouped),'{}'),
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_name',source_name,'row_id',row_id,'reason','active_row_original_population_missing') ORDER BY source_name,row_id)
   FROM active WHERE first_operation NOT IN ('baseline','INSERT')
    -- A seat vacated before capture began and re-opened afterwards: its first
    -- captured event is the UPDATE that opened this occupancy (see 20260928153000).
    AND NOT (source_name='table_seats' AND first_operation='UPDATE' AND EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT e.before_row FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
       WHERE e.source_name='table_seats' AND e.row_id=active.row_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 1) f
     WHERE f.before_row->>'left_at' IS NOT NULL
      AND (f.before_row->>'left_at')::timestamptz<=(SELECT c.captured_at FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_capture c WHERE c.singleton)))),'[]')
  ||COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_name',s.o_source_name,'row_id',s.o_row_id,'source_event_id',s.o_event_id,'reason','original_inventory_chain_disagrees') ORDER BY s.o_source_name,s.o_row_id,s.o_event_id)
   FROM s WHERE s.o_kind='issue'),'[]') INTO population,gaps;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('population',population,'issues',gaps);
END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_state(p_ba.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_inventory_state(p_base timestamp with time zone, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(o_kind text, o_source_name text, o_row_id uuid, o_event_id bigint, o_first_operation text, o_after_row jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET work_mem TO '64MB'
 SET enable_indexscan TO 'off'
 SET max_parallel_workers_per_gather TO '0'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Plain index scans are off: measured on production 2026-09-28, a cold week
 -- range read through the boundary index one heap page at a time costs
 -- ~235us an event (7.8M events: ~30 min); the same range as a bitmap heap
 -- scan, pages in physical order, ~45us (~6 min), less in parallel.
 IF p_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_at) OR (p_base IS NOT NULL AND (NOT isfinite(p_base) OR p_base>p_at)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_inventory_state_window' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 -- A sealed boundary already contains the exact state: no delta exists.
 IF p_base=p_at THEN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'row'::text,r.source_name,r.row_id,r.latest_event_id,r.first_operation,r.after_row
   FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_published_rows r WHERE r.boundary=p_base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'issue'::text,i.source_name,i.row_id,i.event_id,NULL::text,NULL::jsonb
   FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_published_issues i WHERE i.boundary=p_base;
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH d AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.source_name sn,e.row_id rid,e.event_id eid,e.operation op,
   jsonb_hash_extended(e.before_row,0) b0,jsonb_hash_extended(e.before_row,1) b1,
   jsonb_hash_extended(e.after_row,0) a0,jsonb_hash_extended(e.after_row,1) a1
  FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
  WHERE e.observed_at>=COALESCE(p_base,'-infinity'::timestamptz) AND e.observed_at<p_at
 ), b AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.source_name sn,r.row_id rid,r.latest_event_id eid,r.first_operation fop,r.after_row,
   jsonb_hash_extended(r.after_row,0) a0,jsonb_hash_extended(r.after_row,1) a1
  FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_published_rows r WHERE r.boundary=p_base
 ), t AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.sn,d.rid,min(d.eid) min_id,max(d.eid) max_id FROM d GROUP BY d.sn,d.rid
 ), x AS MATERIALIZED (
  -- A delta event ordered (by event_id) before the row's last pre-base event:
  -- that row's whole chain is re-read below instead of continued.
  SELECT t.sn,t.rid FROM t JOIN b ON b.sn=t.sn AND b.rid=t.rid WHERE t.min_id<b.eid
 ), w AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.sn,d.rid,d.eid,d.b0,d.b1,
   row_number() OVER p k,lag(d.a0) OVER p pa0,lag(d.a1) OVER p pa1,first_value(d.op) OVER p fop
  FROM d WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM x WHERE x.sn=d.sn AND x.rid=d.rid)
  WINDOW p AS (PARTITION BY d.sn,d.rid ORDER BY d.eid)
 ), tl AS MATERIALIZED (
  -- The latest row image of each continued row, fetched in one pass in
  -- physical order rather than one random heap read per row.
  SELECT e.event_id eid,e.after_row FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
  WHERE e.event_id=ANY(ARRAY(SELECT t.max_id FROM t WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM x WHERE x.sn=t.sn AND x.rid=t.rid)))
 ), xh AS MATERIALIZED (
  -- LATERAL: always one identity-index read per interleaved row, never a join
  -- plan that scans the history.
  SELECT e.sn,e.rid,e.eid,e.before_row,e.after_row,
   row_number() OVER p k,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY e.sn,e.rid ORDER BY e.eid DESC) latest,
   lag(e.after_row) OVER p prior_after,first_value(e.op) OVER p fop
  FROM x CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT h.source_name sn,h.row_id rid,h.event_id eid,h.operation op,h.before_row,h.after_row
   FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events h WHERE h.source_name=x.sn AND h.row_id=x.rid AND h.observed_at<p_at) e
  WINDOW p AS (PARTITION BY e.sn,e.rid ORDER BY e.eid)
 )
 SELECT 'row'::text,b.sn,b.rid,b.eid,b.fop,b.after_row FROM b
  WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE t.sn=b.sn AND t.rid=b.rid)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'row',t.sn,t.rid,t.max_id,COALESCE(b.fop,w.fop),tl.after_row
  FROM t JOIN w ON w.sn=t.sn AND w.rid=t.rid AND w.k=1
  JOIN tl ON tl.eid=t.max_id
  LEFT JOIN b ON b.sn=t.sn AND b.rid=t.rid
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'row',xh.sn,xh.rid,xh.eid,xh.fop,xh.after_row FROM xh WHERE xh.latest=1
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'issue',i.source_name,i.row_id,i.event_id,NULL::text,NULL::jsonb FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_published_issues i
  WHERE i.boundary=p_base AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM x WHERE x.sn=i.source_name AND x.rid=i.row_id)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'issue',w.sn,w.rid,w.eid,NULL,NULL FROM w WHERE w.k>1 AND (w.pa0,w.pa1) IS DISTINCT FROM (w.b0,w.b1)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'issue',w.sn,w.rid,w.eid,NULL,NULL FROM w JOIN b ON b.sn=w.sn AND b.rid=w.rid
  WHERE w.k=1 AND (b.a0,b.a1) IS DISTINCT FROM (w.b0,w.b1)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'issue',xh.sn,xh.rid,xh.eid,NULL,NULL FROM xh WHERE xh.k>1 AND xh.prior_after IS DISTINCT FROM xh.before_row;
END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_linked_cash_outcomes.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_linked_cash_outcomes(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(table_id uuid, hand_number bigint, game_scope jsonb, evidence jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET enable_nestloop TO 'off'
AS $function$ BEGIN IF md5(pg_get_functiondef('smarter_private.original_lightning_funding_owner_evidence(uuid,bigint,jsonb,jsonb)'::regprocedure))IS DISTINCT FROM 'b171ac61a57a9ce56c46a6529676c604'THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_lightning_funding_owner_reader_changed';END IF; PERFORM 1 FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions LIMIT 0; IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c WHERE c.conrelid='public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions'::regclass AND c.conname='union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions_check' AND c.contype='c' AND c.convalidated AND pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid)='CHECK ((proof_md5 = md5((proof)::text)))') OR (SELECT count(*)FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions'::regclass AND attname IN('proof','proof_md5')AND attnotnull AND NOT attisdropped)<>2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'linked_proof_contract_changed';END IF; RETURN QUERY EXECUTE $query$
 SELECT r.table_id,r.hand_number,r.game_scope,CASE WHEN r.roster_source='lightning_pool' THEN smarter_private.original_lightning_funding_owner_evidence(r.table_id,r.hand_number,r.game_scope,r.evidence) ELSE r.evidence END
 FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions r
 JOIN public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes o ON o.table_id=r.table_id AND o.hand_number=r.hand_number
 WHERE r.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=$1::text AND o.recognized_at>=$2 AND o.recognized_at<$3
  AND r.hand_id=o.hand_id AND r.outcome_payload_hash=o.payload_hash AND r.outcome_evidence_md5=md5(o.evidence::text)
  
$query$ USING p_union_id,p_start,p_end;END $function$

public.fn_union_pnl_opening_registration.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_opening_registration_resolution(p_union_id uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone, p_tournament jsonb, p_registration jsonb)
 RETURNS SETOF union_pnl_opening_registration_resolutions
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT r.* FROM public.union_pnl_opening_registration_resolutions r
 WHERE r.boundary=p_at AND r.registration_id::text=p_registration->>'id' AND r.union_id=p_union_id
  AND p_tournament->>'union_id'=p_union_id::text AND p_registration->>'tournament_id'=p_tournament->>'id'
  AND r.tournament_id::text=p_tournament->>'id' AND r.user_id::text=p_registration->>'user_id'
  AND r.registration_row_md5=md5(p_registration::text) AND r.tournament_row_md5=md5(p_tournament::text)
  AND r.proof_md5=md5(r.proof::text) AND r.proof->>'status'='proven'
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_original_flow_eviden.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_original_flow_evidence(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(ledger_id uuid, club_id uuid, user_id uuid, buyins numeric, cashouts numeric, kind text, valid boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH originals AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.*,q.ledger_snapshot l,(q.game_scope->>'tournament_id')::uuid tournament_id
  FROM public.union_pnl_original_flows q WHERE q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text
   AND q.recognized_at>=p_start AND q.recognized_at<p_end
 ), rf_original_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.transaction_id,(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid table_id,
   (q.l->>'club_id')::uuid club_id,(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid user_id,(q.l->>'amount')::numeric amount
  FROM originals q
  WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
   AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='player_funding'
 ), rf_original_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT k.transaction_id,k.table_id,k.club_id,k.user_id,k.amount,count(*) refunds,
   min(o.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,min(o.user_id::text)::uuid player
  FROM rf_original_keys k
  JOIN public.cash_funding_application_receipts a ON a.transaction_id=k.transaction_id
   AND a.refunded>0 AND a.refunded=k.amount
  JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts o ON o.id=a.funding_receipt_id
  WHERE a.pending_addon_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.pending_addon_id AND a.original_occupancy_id=o.occupancy_id
   AND o.table_id=k.table_id AND o.account_type='player_wallet' AND o.account_entity_id=k.user_id
   AND o.funding_club_id=k.club_id AND o.user_id=k.user_id
  GROUP BY k.transaction_id,k.table_id,k.club_id,k.user_id,k.amount
 ), bbj_wallet_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.ledger_id,(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid club_id,r.user_id,r.amount,b.id payout_id
  FROM originals q
  JOIN public.bbj_payouts b ON b.id=CASE WHEN q.l->>'idempotency_key' ~ '^bbj:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN split_part(q.l->>'idempotency_key',':',2)::uuid END
  JOIN public.bbj_payout_recipients r ON r.payout_id=b.id AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid
  JOIN public.wallet_credit_idempotency w ON w.key=q.l->>'idempotency_key' AND w.user_id=r.user_id AND w.amount=r.amount
  JOIN public.bbj_pools pool ON pool.id=b.pool_id
  WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'category'='bbj_payout' AND q.l->>'status'='posted'
   AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet'
   AND q.l->>'from_entity_id'=b.table_id::text AND q.l->>'table_id'=b.table_id::text
   AND q.l->>'id'=q.ledger_id::text AND q.l->>'idempotency_key'='bbj:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text
   AND q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text AND q.game_scope->>'asset'='chips' AND q.game_scope->'unit_scale'='2'::jsonb
   AND (pool.union_id=p_union_id OR (pool.union_id IS NULL AND pool.club_id::text=q.game_scope->>'host_club_id'))
   AND b.kind IN('main','mini') AND b.total_amount>0 AND b.total_amount=round(b.total_amount,2)
   AND b.created_at<=q.recognized_at AND r.created_at=w.created_at AND w.created_at>=b.created_at AND w.created_at<=q.recognized_at
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients unique_recipient WHERE unique_recipient.payout_id=b.id AND unique_recipient.user_id=r.user_id)=1
   AND r.amount=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric AND r.amount>0 AND r.amount=round(r.amount,2)
   AND r.amount::text NOT IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_transactions t WHERE t.transaction_type='bbj_payout' AND t.table_id=b.table_id
     AND t.to_user_id=r.user_id AND t.club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid AND t.amount=r.amount AND t.created_at=w.created_at)=1
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger bank WHERE bank.status='posted' AND bank.category='bbj_payout'
     AND bank.from_type='bbj_pool' AND bank.from_entity_id=b.pool_id AND bank.to_type='table_stack' AND bank.to_entity_id=b.table_id
     AND bank.amount=b.total_amount AND bank.idempotency_key=CASE WHEN b.kind='mini' THEN 'bbj_mini:'||b.pool_id::text||':'||b.table_id::text||':'||b.hand_number::text ELSE 'bbj_payout:'||b.id::text END)=1
   AND (SELECT coalesce(sum(p.amount),0) FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients p WHERE p.payout_id=b.id)
      +(SELECT coalesce(sum(u.amount),0) FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.paid_at IS NULL)=b.total_amount
   AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.user_id=r.user_id)
     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.user_id=r.user_id AND u.amount=r.amount
       AND u.pool_id=b.pool_id AND u.table_id=b.table_id AND u.paid_at=w.created_at
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger parked WHERE parked.status='posted' AND parked.category='bbj_payout'
         AND parked.from_type='table_stack' AND parked.from_entity_id=b.table_id AND parked.to_type='bbj_pool' AND parked.to_entity_id=b.pool_id
         AND parked.amount=r.amount AND parked.idempotency_key='bbj_park:bbj:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text)=1
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger redeemed WHERE redeemed.status='posted' AND redeemed.category='bbj_payout'
         AND redeemed.from_type='bbj_pool' AND redeemed.from_entity_id=b.pool_id AND redeemed.to_type='table_stack' AND redeemed.to_entity_id=b.table_id
         AND redeemed.amount=r.amount AND redeemed.idempotency_key='bbj_redeem:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text)=1)=1)
 ), matched AS (
  SELECT q.*,gift.proof treasury_gift,returned.proof treasury_return,f.id cash_funding_id,f.funding_club_id cash_club,f.user_id cash_user,f.amount cash_amount,
   e.id entry_id,e.funding_club_id entry_club,e.user_id entry_user,e.amount entry_amount,
   c.ledger_id credit_id,c.credited_club_id credit_club,c.user_id credit_user,c.amount credit_amount,
   ret.owners,ret.funding_club_id return_club,ret.user_id return_user,mv.moved_club,mv.moved_user,
   COALESCE(rf.refunds,0) refunds,rf.club refund_club,rf.player refund_user,te.refund_ent,te.refund_ent_user,te.refund_ent_club,te.refund_ent_wallet_club,te.refund_ent_funding_club,late.n late_count,late.club late_club,late.player late_user,late.delta late_delta,j.club_id bbj_club,j.user_id bbj_user,j.payout_id bbj_payout
  FROM originals q
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT smarter_private.original_treasury_gift_evidence(q.ledger_id) proof
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'category'='horse_funding'
    AND q.l->>'from_type'='club_treasury' AND q.l->>'to_type'='table_stack') gift ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT smarter_private.original_treasury_return_evidence(q.ledger_id) proof
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'category' IN('cashout','table_cashout','refund')
    AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet') returned ON true
  LEFT JOIN bbj_wallet_matches j ON j.ledger_id=q.ledger_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(*) n,min(p.club_id::text)::uuid club,min(p.user_id::text)::uuid player,min(p.delta) delta
   FROM (SELECT q.ledger_id WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL
    AND q.l->>'category'='settlement' AND q.l->>'idempotency_key' LIKE 'late_seat_settle:%' OFFSET 0) eligible
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.fn_union_pnl_prove_late_settlement(eligible.ledger_id) p
  ) late ON true
  -- One-time filter (20261001): a probe only for the flows that can match.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT f.* FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND f.source_ledger_id=q.ledger_id OFFSET 0) f ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.* FROM public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts e
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND e.ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND e.asset='chips' AND q.tournament_id=e.tournament_id OFFSET 0) e ON true
  -- fn_union_pnl_tournament_returns(q.tournament_id,NULL,p_start,p_end) for
  -- this flow's ledger only: its two branches verbatim, keyed by the ledger.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT c.ledger_id,c.tournament_id,c.user_id,c.credited_club_id,c.amount
   FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c
   JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=c.transaction_id
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND c.ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND c.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND b.observed_at>=p_start AND b.observed_at<p_end
   UNION ALL
   SELECT t.credit_ledger_id,t.tournament_id,t.user_id,t.source_wallet_club_id,t.amount_paid_now
   FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches t
   JOIN public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.entitlement_id=t.entitlement_id
   JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=t.transaction_id
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND t.credit_ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND t.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND b.observed_at>=p_start AND b.observed_at<p_end
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c2 WHERE c2.ledger_id=t.credit_ledger_id)
  ) c ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(DISTINCT (r.funding_club_id,r.user_id)) owners,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid funding_club_id,min(r.user_id::text)::uuid user_id
   FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'occupancy_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN (COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'occupancy_id')::uuid END occupancy_id
    FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i
    WHERE i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats'
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'table_id'=((q.l->>'table_id')::uuid)::text
    UNION
    SELECT original.occupancy_id FROM public.cash_funding_application_receipts a
     JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts original ON original.id=a.funding_receipt_id
     WHERE a.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND a.refunded=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
   ) original_occupancies
   JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.occupancy_id=original_occupancies.occupancy_id
   WHERE r.table_id=(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid AND smarter_private.cash_initial_funding_receipt(r.id)
    AND q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
    AND ((r.account_type=q.l->>'to_type' AND r.account_entity_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid) OR (r.operation_kind='horse_funding' AND r.account_type='club_treasury' AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid AND smarter_private.cash_initial_funding_receipt(r.id)))
    AND r.funding_club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid
    AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i WHERE i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats'
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'occupancy_id'=r.occupancy_id::text
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'table_id'=r.table_id::text)
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_funding_application_receipts a JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts original ON original.id=a.funding_receipt_id
       WHERE a.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND original.occupancy_id=r.occupancy_id AND a.refunded=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric))
  ) ret ON true
  -- A seat cashed out after it arrived by a table move holds chips whose
  -- original buy-in is on the source occupancy, not this one. The occupancy
  -- the cash-out vacated (its seat row in the same original transaction,
  -- carrying exactly the cashed-out stack) is traced through its move receipts
  -- by fn_cash_original_funding_lineage, the proof the boundaries and hands
  -- already use; the owner is its one original buy-in's club and player.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT CASE WHEN lin.v->'issues'='[]'::jsonb AND jsonb_array_length(lin.v->'moves')>0 AND own.receipts>0 AND own.buyins=1
     AND own.clubs=1 AND own.users=1 AND own.club::text=q.l->>'club_id' AND own.player::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id'
     THEN own.club END moved_club,
    CASE WHEN lin.v->'issues'='[]'::jsonb AND jsonb_array_length(lin.v->'moves')>0 AND own.receipts>0 AND own.buyins=1
     AND own.clubs=1 AND own.users=1 AND own.club::text=q.l->>'club_id' AND own.player::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id'
     THEN own.player END moved_user
   FROM (SELECT min(i.before_row::text)::jsonb seat,count(*) n FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i
     WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet'
      AND ret.owners IS DISTINCT FROM 1
      AND i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats' AND i.before_row->>'table_id'=q.l->>'table_id'
      AND i.before_row->>'user_id'=q.l->>'to_entity_id' AND i.before_row->'left_at'='null'::jsonb
      AND i.after_row->>'left_at' IS NOT NULL) s
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.fn_cash_original_funding_lineage((s.seat->>'user_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'table_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'id')::uuid,
     (s.seat->>'occupancy_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'joined_at')::timestamptz,q.recognized_at,false) v) lin
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) receipts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE smarter_private.cash_initial_funding_receipt(r.id)) buyins,count(DISTINCT r.funding_club_id) clubs,
     count(DISTINCT r.user_id) users,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,min(r.user_id::text)::uuid player
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(lin.v->'funding_receipts') ref JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.id=(ref->>'id')::uuid) own
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND ret.owners IS DISTINCT FROM 1
    AND s.n=1 AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(s.seat->'stack') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (q.l->>'amount')::numeric
  ) mv ON true
  -- A pending add-on returned unapplied is a refund of this player's own
  -- escrowed chips. Its wallet credit can carry no refund category: it runs
  -- inside the hand's post-commit obligations, after atomic_distribute_rake
  -- has declared that transaction's ledger context, so the audit labels it
  -- player_funding under the rake settlement. The application receipt
  -- written in the same transaction proves it: exactly one refund of this
  -- amount from a funding receipt of this player, club and table.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT r.refunds,r.club,r.player FROM rf_original_matches r
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
    AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='player_funding'
    AND r.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND r.table_id=(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid
    AND r.club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid
    AND r.amount=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
  ) rf ON true
  -- A seat won in a satellite and later refunded by the target tournament
  -- (cancelled, or the seat released) pays the seat's value back to the
  -- player's wallet from the target's prize liability. That seat was never a
  -- wallet-funded entry of the target, so no tournament credit receipt exists
  -- for it; its proof is the refund entitlement the payout is keyed by: same
  -- tournament, player, wallet club and gross, and the seat's owning club as
  -- resolved from its satellite registration.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   -- THE FUNDING CLUB BEARS ITS SATELLITE SEAT REFUND (owner ruling 2026-11-11).
   -- A seat's owner is the club whose wallet paid the satellite entry, read
   -- from its wallet-funded entry receipt by fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner.
   -- When the player has since left that club, the won seat is admitted and
   -- refunded at another club, and the arm below proves that whole original
   -- lineage. That refund is the funding club's return; the receipt in the
   -- other club's wallet is an inter-club transfer, named by
   -- refund_ent_wallet_club and admitted in the ownership predicate. No
   -- ledger, wallet or settled payout changes; live membership is never read.
   SELECT t.id refund_ent,t.user_id refund_ent_user,COALESCE(dep.club,t.refund_wallet_club_id) refund_ent_club,
    t.refund_wallet_club_id refund_ent_wallet_club,dep.club refund_ent_funding_club
   FROM public.tournament_refund_entitlements t
   LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT f.club FROM (SELECT public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner(t.registration_id,t.tournament_id) club) f
    WHERE t.entitlement_kind='satellite_seat' AND f.club IS NOT NULL AND f.club<>t.refund_wallet_club_id) dep ON true
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND t.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND q.l->>'idempotency_key'='tourney:'||t.tournament_id::text||':refund-entitlement:'||t.id::text
    AND t.entitlement_kind IN('satellite_seat','wallet_charge','tournament_ticket') AND t.gross=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
    AND t.user_id::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id' AND t.refund_wallet_club_id::text=q.l->>'club_id'
    AND q.l->>'from_type'='prize_liability' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='refund'
    AND CASE t.entitlement_kind
     WHEN 'satellite_seat' THEN
      public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner(t.registration_id,NULL)=t.refund_wallet_club_id
      OR (
       -- SATELLITE REFUNDS FOLLOW THE ADMITTED CLUB (01a1c81a).
       -- The upstream entry proves backing, not the club of an already won
       -- target seat. Both atomic award producers have used the admitted
       -- registration's club since 20260918. Prove that original award and
       -- its one full cash refund; never infer ownership from live membership.
       public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner(t.registration_id,t.tournament_id) IS NOT NULL
       AND t.charge_category='satellite_seat' AND t.evidence_kind='atomic_satellite_seat'
       AND q.l->>'from_entity_id'=t.tournament_id::text
       AND t.gross=t.refund_prize+t.refund_bounty+t.refund_fee
       AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_tickets replacement WHERE replacement.source_refund_entitlement_id=t.id)
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches tr
        WHERE tr.entitlement_id=t.id AND tr.credit_ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND tr.transaction_id=q.transaction_id
         AND tr.tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND tr.user_id=t.user_id
         AND tr.source_wallet_club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id
         AND tr.idempotency_key=q.l->>'idempotency_key' AND tr.amount_paid_before=0 AND tr.amount_paid_now=t.gross
         AND tr.refund_prize=t.refund_prize AND tr.refund_bounty=t.refund_bounty AND tr.refund_fee=t.refund_fee)=1
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches tr WHERE tr.entitlement_id=t.id)=1
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_entitlements duplicate WHERE duplicate.source_ledger_id=t.source_ledger_id)=1
       AND (SELECT count(*)
        FROM public.tournament_satellite_awards a
        JOIN public.tournament_satellite_settlements h ON h.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
        JOIN public.tournament_payouts p ON p.id=a.payout_id
        JOIN public.chip_ledger admission ON admission.id=t.source_ledger_id
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
         SELECT e.after_row r FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
          WHERE e.source_name='tournament_players' AND e.row_id=t.registration_id
          ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 1
        ) reg
        WHERE a.tournament_id=t.source_satellite_id AND a.registration_id=t.registration_id
         AND a.user_id=t.user_id AND a.place=t.source_award_place AND a.delivery_kind='seat'
         AND a.ticket_id IS NULL AND a.payout_source='satellite_seat' AND a.amount=t.gross
         AND h.target_id=t.tournament_id AND h.ticket_cost=t.gross
         AND h.target_buy_in=t.refund_prize+t.refund_bounty AND h.target_fee=t.refund_fee
         AND p.tournament_id=a.tournament_id AND p.user_id=a.user_id AND p.amount=a.amount
         AND p.source=a.payout_source AND p.idempotency_key=a.idempotency_key
         AND (p.position=a.place OR h.receipt_version>=3)
         AND reg.r->>'id'=t.registration_id::text AND reg.r->>'user_id'=t.user_id::text
         AND reg.r->>'tournament_id'=t.tournament_id::text
         AND reg.r->>'source_satellite_id'=t.source_satellite_id::text
         AND reg.r->>'club_id'=t.refund_wallet_club_id::text
         AND admission.status='posted' AND admission.row_hash IS NOT NULL
         AND admission.from_type='prize_liability' AND admission.from_entity_id=t.source_satellite_id
         AND admission.to_type='prize_liability' AND admission.to_entity_id=t.tournament_id
         AND admission.tournament_id=t.source_satellite_id AND admission.club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id
         AND admission.category='tournament_buyin' AND admission.amount=t.gross
         AND admission.idempotency_key=a.idempotency_key||':pool_transfer'
         AND admission.metadata->>'kind'='satellite_seat_pool_transfer'
         AND admission.metadata->>'satellite_id'=t.source_satellite_id::text
         AND admission.metadata->>'satellite_target_id'=t.tournament_id::text
         AND admission.metadata->>'registration_id'=t.registration_id::text
         AND admission.metadata->>'user_id'=t.user_id::text
         AND (admission.metadata->>'moved')::numeric=t.gross
         AND (admission.metadata->>'unbacked')::numeric=0
         AND (admission.metadata->>'seat_value')::numeric=t.gross
         AND CASE WHEN t.escrow_bucket='satellite_in' THEN
           t.refund_bounty=0 AND admission.metadata->>'entry_split_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '2'
          ELSE t.escrow_bucket='satellite_gross' AND admission.metadata->>'entry_split_version'='2'
           AND (admission.metadata->>'entry_prize')::numeric=t.refund_prize
           AND (admission.metadata->>'entry_bounty')::numeric=t.refund_bounty
           AND (admission.metadata->>'entry_fee')::numeric=t.refund_fee END)=1
      )
     -- A pre-capture wallet entry refunded by cancellation (20261006154000):
     -- its entitlement's source ledger is the entry proven at the opening
     -- boundary of the refund's own week, for this exact registration, club
     -- and gross.
     WHEN 'wallet_charge' THEN t.source_ledger_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.union_pnl_opening_registration_resolutions r
       WHERE r.boundary=public.fn_union_week_start(q.recognized_at) AND r.union_id=p_union_id AND r.tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND r.user_id=t.user_id
        AND r.owning_club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id AND r.entries=1 AND r.entry_amount=t.gross AND r.returned=0
        AND r.proof_md5=md5(r.proof::text)
        AND r.proof->'entry_ledger' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('ledger_id',t.source_ledger_id::text)))=1
     WHEN 'tournament_ticket' THEN t.charge_category='tournament_ticket'
      AND t.evidence_kind='atomic_tournament_ticket' AND t.escrow_bucket='ticket_gross'
      AND q.l->>'from_entity_id'=t.tournament_id::text
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_tickets replacement WHERE replacement.source_refund_entitlement_id=t.id)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_entitlements duplicate WHERE duplicate.source_ticket_id=t.source_ticket_id)=1
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches tr
       WHERE tr.entitlement_id=t.id AND tr.credit_ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND tr.transaction_id=q.transaction_id
        AND tr.tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND tr.user_id=t.user_id AND tr.source_wallet_club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id
        AND tr.idempotency_key=q.l->>'idempotency_key' AND tr.amount_paid_before=0 AND tr.amount_paid_now=t.gross
        AND tr.refund_prize=t.refund_prize AND tr.refund_bounty=t.refund_bounty AND tr.refund_fee=t.refund_fee)=1
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches tr WHERE tr.entitlement_id=t.id)=1
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_tickets tk
       JOIN public.chip_ledger admission ON admission.id=t.source_ledger_id
       JOIN public.tournament_satellite_awards a ON a.ticket_id=tk.id
       JOIN public.tournament_satellite_settlements h ON h.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
       JOIN public.tournament_payouts p ON p.id=a.payout_id
       JOIN public.chip_ledger issue ON issue.idempotency_key=a.idempotency_key||':ticket_escrow'
       WHERE tk.id=t.source_ticket_id AND tk.holder_id=t.user_id AND tk.club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id
        AND tk.status='redeemed' AND tk.redemption_mode='tournament_entry_only' AND tk.cancelled_at IS NULL
        AND tk.value=t.gross AND tk.entry_prize=t.refund_prize AND tk.entry_bounty=t.refund_bounty AND tk.entry_fee=t.refund_fee
        AND t.gross=t.refund_prize+t.refund_bounty+t.refund_fee
        AND tk.source_tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND tk.source_satellite_id=t.source_satellite_id
        -- Only the original direct award is admitted here. A replacement
        -- ticket still requires its distinct original refund disposition.
        AND tk.source_refund_entitlement_id IS NULL
        AND a.tournament_id=tk.source_satellite_id AND a.place=tk.source_satellite_award_place
        AND a.user_id=t.user_id AND a.delivery_kind='ticket' AND a.amount=t.gross AND a.payout_source='satellite_ticket'
        AND p.tournament_id=a.tournament_id AND p.user_id=a.user_id AND p.amount=a.amount
        AND p.source=a.payout_source AND p.idempotency_key=a.idempotency_key
        AND (p.position=a.place OR h.receipt_version>=3)
        AND h.target_id=t.tournament_id AND h.ticket_cost=t.gross
        AND h.target_buy_in=tk.entry_prize+tk.entry_bounty AND h.target_fee=tk.entry_fee
        AND issue.status='posted' AND issue.category='ticket_issue' AND issue.amount=t.gross
        AND issue.club_id=tk.club_id AND issue.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
        AND issue.from_type='prize_liability' AND issue.from_entity_id=a.tournament_id
        AND issue.to_type='escrow' AND issue.to_entity_id=tk.id
        AND issue.metadata->>'kind'='direct_satellite_entry_ticket'
        AND issue.metadata->>'ticket_id'=tk.id::text AND issue.metadata->>'payout_id'=p.id::text
        AND issue.metadata->>'user_id'=t.user_id::text
        AND issue.metadata->>'satellite_target_id'=t.tournament_id::text
        AND COALESCE(issue.metadata->>'position',issue.metadata->>'award_slot')=a.place::text
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.wallet_credit_idempotency w WHERE w.key=a.idempotency_key)
        AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_transactions x
          WHERE x.transaction_type='tournament_ticket_issue' AND x.club_id=tk.club_id
           AND x.from_user_id IS NULL AND x.to_user_id=t.user_id AND x.amount=t.gross
           AND x.metadata->>'ticket_id'=tk.id::text AND x.metadata->>'ledger_id'=issue.id::text
           AND x.metadata->>'payout_id'=p.id::text AND x.metadata->>'idempotency_key'=a.idempotency_key
           AND x.metadata->>'source_tournament_id'=t.tournament_id::text
           AND x.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=a.tournament_id::text
           AND x.metadata->>'source_award_place'=a.place::text)=1
        AND admission.status='posted' AND admission.category='ticket_redeem' AND admission.amount=t.gross
        AND admission.club_id=tk.club_id AND admission.tournament_id=t.tournament_id
        AND admission.from_type='escrow' AND admission.from_entity_id=tk.id
        AND admission.to_type='prize_liability' AND admission.to_entity_id=t.tournament_id
        AND admission.idempotency_key='ticket:'||tk.id::text||':tournament:'||t.tournament_id::text||':entry'
        AND admission.metadata->>'kind'='tournament_entry_ticket_admission'
        AND admission.metadata->>'ticket_id'=tk.id::text AND admission.metadata->>'user_id'=t.user_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->>'registration_id'=t.registration_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->>'source_tournament_id'=t.tournament_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=t.source_satellite_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->'entry_prize'=to_jsonb(t.refund_prize)
        AND admission.metadata->'entry_bounty'=to_jsonb(t.refund_bounty)
        AND admission.metadata->'entry_fee'=to_jsonb(t.refund_fee))=1
     ELSE false END
  ) te ON true
 ), projected AS (
  SELECT *,CASE WHEN bbj_payout IS NOT NULL THEN 'cash_return' WHEN late_count=1 THEN 'cash_late_settlement' WHEN treasury_gift->>'status'='proven' THEN 'cash_funding' WHEN treasury_return->>'status'='proven' THEN 'cash_return' WHEN cash_funding_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'cash_funding' WHEN owners=1 OR moved_club IS NOT NULL OR refunds=1 THEN 'cash_return'
    WHEN entry_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'tournament_funding' WHEN credit_id IS NOT NULL OR refund_ent IS NOT NULL THEN 'tournament_return' ELSE 'unsupported' END k,
   COALESCE(bbj_club,late_club,(treasury_gift->>'earning_club')::uuid,(treasury_return->>'earning_club')::uuid,cash_club,CASE WHEN moved_club IS NOT NULL THEN moved_club WHEN owners=1 THEN return_club ELSE refund_club END,entry_club,credit_club,refund_ent_club) owner_club,
   COALESCE(bbj_user,late_user,(treasury_gift->>'user_id')::uuid,(treasury_return->>'user_id')::uuid,cash_user,CASE WHEN moved_club IS NOT NULL THEN moved_user WHEN owners=1 THEN return_user ELSE refund_user END,entry_user,credit_user,refund_ent_user) owner_user
  FROM matched
 ) SELECT ledger_id,owner_club,owner_user,
  CASE WHEN k='cash_late_settlement' AND late_delta<0 THEN -late_delta WHEN k IN('cash_funding','tournament_funding') THEN (l->>'amount')::numeric ELSE 0 END,
  CASE WHEN k='cash_late_settlement' AND late_delta>0 THEN late_delta WHEN k IN('cash_return','tournament_return') THEN (l->>'amount')::numeric ELSE 0 END,k,
  (l->>'status'='posted' AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(l->'amount')>0 AND owner_club IS NOT NULL AND owner_user IS NOT NULL
   AND (owner_club::text=l->>'club_id' OR (treasury_gift->>'status'='proven' AND treasury_gift->>'ledger_id'=ledger_id::text AND treasury_gift->>'sponsor_bank_club'=l->>'club_id' AND treasury_gift->>'earning_club'=owner_club::text)
    -- INTER-CLUB TRANSFER (owner ruling 2026-11-11): a proven satellite seat
    -- refund paid into another club's wallet is its funding club's return.
    OR (k='tournament_return' AND refund_ent IS NOT NULL AND entry_id IS NULL AND credit_id IS NULL
     AND refund_ent_funding_club IS NOT NULL AND owner_club=refund_ent_funding_club AND refund_ent_club=refund_ent_funding_club
     AND refund_ent_wallet_club::text=l->>'club_id' AND refund_ent_wallet_club<>refund_ent_funding_club)) AND game_scope->>'asset'='chips' AND game_scope->'unit_scale'='2'::jsonb
   AND CASE k
    WHEN 'cash_late_settlement' THEN late_count=1 AND abs(late_delta)=(l->>'amount')::numeric
