    WHEN 'cash_funding' THEN (cash_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric OR (treasury_gift->>'status'='proven' AND (treasury_gift->>'amount')::numeric=(l->>'amount')::numeric)) AND l->>'to_type'='table_stack' AND l->>'category' IN('buyin','rebuy','addon','horse_funding')
    WHEN 'cash_return' THEN ((treasury_return->>'status'='proven' AND (treasury_return->>'amount')::numeric=(l->>'amount')::numeric) OR bbj_payout IS NOT NULL OR owners=1 OR moved_club IS NOT NULL OR (refunds=1 AND l->>'category'='player_funding')) AND l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND (l->>'category' IN('cashout','table_cashout','refund')
     OR (l->>'category'='player_funding' AND refunds=1 AND refund_club=owner_club AND refund_user=owner_user)
     OR (l->>'category'='bbj_payout' AND bbj_payout IS NOT NULL AND bbj_club=owner_club AND bbj_user=owner_user))
    WHEN 'tournament_funding' THEN entry_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric AND l->>'to_type'='prize_liability' AND l->>'category' IN('tournament_buyin','rebuy','addon')
    WHEN 'tournament_return' THEN (credit_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric OR (credit_id IS NULL AND refund_ent IS NOT NULL)) AND l->>'from_type'='prize_liability' AND l->>'category' IN('tournament_prize','prize','bounty','refund','tournament_refund')
    ELSE false END) IS TRUE
 FROM projected
 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM smarter_private.original_restoration_cash_returns(p_union_id,p_start,p_end)
 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM smarter_private.original_erased_cash_discharge_returns(p_union_id,p_start,p_end);
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner(p_registration_id uuid, p_tournament_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH reg AS (
  SELECT e.after_row r FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
  WHERE e.source_name='tournament_players' AND e.row_id=p_registration_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 1
 ), who AS (
  SELECT (r->>'user_id')::uuid user_id,(r->>'source_satellite_id')::uuid satellite_id,(r->>'registered_at')::timestamptz registered_at,
   (r->>'tournament_id')::uuid target_id,(r->>'club_id')::uuid admission_club_id
  FROM reg WHERE (p_tournament_id IS NULL OR r->>'tournament_id'=p_tournament_id::text)
   AND r->>'source_satellite_id' IS NOT NULL AND r->>'user_id' IS NOT NULL AND r->>'tournament_id' IS NOT NULL
 ), award AS (
  SELECT a.tournament_id,a.user_id FROM who w
  JOIN public.tournament_satellite_awards a ON a.tournament_id=w.satellite_id AND a.user_id=w.user_id
  JOIN public.tournament_satellite_settlements s ON s.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
  WHERE (a.delivery_kind='seat' AND a.registration_id=p_registration_id AND s.target_id=w.target_id)
   OR (a.delivery_kind='ticket' AND a.registration_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_tickets t
    WHERE t.id=a.ticket_id AND t.holder_id=w.user_id AND t.source_satellite_id=w.satellite_id
     AND t.status='redeemed' AND t.redemption_mode='tournament_entry_only' AND t.redeemed_at=w.registered_at
     AND CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_payouts p
       WHERE p.tournament_id=t.source_satellite_id AND p.source='satellite_ticket'
        AND p.metadata->>'ticket_id'=t.id::text AND p.metadata->>'ticket_contract'='same_value_entry_v1')
     THEN
      -- Original target remains issuance provenance. A value ticket is consumed
      -- by its one canonical atomic admission into the actual registration.
      public.fn_ca_assert_satellite_value_ticket(t.id)='chips'
      AND t.source_tournament_id=s.target_id
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournaments target
       WHERE target.id=w.target_id AND w.admission_club_id=t.club_id
        AND (target.union_id IS NOT NULL OR target.club_id=t.club_id)
        AND public.fn_poker_diamond_tournament(target.id) IS FALSE
        AND round(COALESCE(target.buy_in_amount,0),2)+round(COALESCE(target.buy_in_fee,0),2)=t.value)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_entitlements e
       JOIN public.chip_ledger l ON l.id=e.source_ledger_id
       JOIN public.tournaments target ON target.id=e.tournament_id
       CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.fn_tournament_entry_split(target.buy_in_amount,target.buy_in_fee,target.bounty_amount,
        COALESCE(target.is_bounty,false) OR COALESCE(target.is_pko,false) OR COALESCE(target.is_mystery_bounty,false)) split
       WHERE e.source_ticket_id=t.id AND e.tournament_id=w.target_id AND e.registration_id=p_registration_id
        AND e.user_id=w.user_id AND e.source_satellite_id=w.satellite_id
        AND e.entitlement_kind='tournament_ticket' AND e.charge_category='tournament_ticket'
        AND e.evidence_kind='atomic_tournament_ticket' AND e.escrow_bucket='ticket_gross'
        AND e.refund_wallet_club_id=t.club_id AND e.gross=t.value
        AND e.refund_prize>=0 AND e.refund_bounty>=0 AND e.refund_fee>=0
        AND e.refund_prize=split.prize AND e.refund_bounty=split.bounty AND e.refund_fee=split.rake AND split.charge=t.value
        AND round(e.refund_prize+e.refund_bounty+e.refund_fee,2)=t.value
        AND e.created_at=w.registered_at
        AND l.idempotency_key='ticket:'||t.id::text||':tournament:'||w.target_id::text||':entry'
        AND l.status='posted' AND l.row_hash IS NOT NULL AND l.category='ticket_redeem'
        AND l.from_type='escrow' AND l.from_entity_id=t.id
        AND l.to_type='prize_liability' AND l.to_entity_id=w.target_id
        AND l.tournament_id=w.target_id AND l.club_id=t.club_id AND l.amount=t.value
        AND l.created_at=w.registered_at
        AND l.metadata->>'kind'='tournament_entry_ticket_admission'
        AND l.metadata->>'ticket_id'=t.id::text AND l.metadata->>'user_id'=w.user_id::text
        AND l.metadata->>'registration_id'=p_registration_id::text
        AND l.metadata->>'source_tournament_id'=s.target_id::text
        AND l.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=w.satellite_id::text
        AND (l.metadata->>'entry_prize')::numeric=e.refund_prize
        AND (l.metadata->>'entry_bounty')::numeric=e.refund_bounty
        AND (l.metadata->>'entry_fee')::numeric=e.refund_fee
        AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_transactions x
         WHERE x.transaction_type='tournament_ticket_entry' AND x.club_id=t.club_id
          AND x.from_user_id=w.user_id AND x.to_user_id IS NULL AND x.amount=t.value
          AND x.metadata->>'ticket_id'=t.id::text AND x.metadata->>'registration_id'=p_registration_id::text
          AND x.metadata->>'holder_id'=w.user_id::text
          AND x.metadata->>'target_tournament_id'=w.target_id::text
          AND x.metadata->>'entitlement_id'=e.id::text AND x.metadata->>'ledger_id'=l.id::text
          AND x.metadata->>'idempotency_key'=l.idempotency_key
          AND x.metadata->>'wallet_chips_credited'='0')=1)=1
     ELSE s.target_id=w.target_id AND t.source_tournament_id=w.target_id END))
 ), entry AS (
  SELECT count(*) n,count(DISTINCT r.funding_club_id) clubs,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.operation='entry') entries,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.asset IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips' OR r.amount IS NULL OR r.amount<=0 OR r.funding_club_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT row.* FROM public.chip_ledger row WHERE row.id=r.ledger_id OFFSET 0) l WHERE l.status='posted' AND l.from_type='player_wallet' AND l.from_entity_id=r.user_id
     AND l.to_type='prize_liability' AND l.to_entity_id=r.tournament_id AND l.tournament_id=r.tournament_id AND l.amount=r.amount
     AND l.club_id=r.funding_club_id AND l.category IN ('tournament_buyin','rebuy','addon') AND l.row_hash IS NOT NULL)) bad
  FROM award a JOIN public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.tournament_id=a.tournament_id AND r.user_id=a.user_id
 -- CHAINED SATELLITE SEATS (20261110235613): a seat produced by a satellite the
 -- player was admitted to by WINNING an upstream satellite has no wallet entry
 -- receipt of its own, so 'entry' above keeps nothing and the seat's owning
 -- club was unresolvable. One hop, never two, and never recursive: the hop is
 -- taken only when the immediate satellite has NO entry receipt at all
 -- (e.entries=0), so a resolvable or a conflicting immediate answer is never
 -- overridden, and it is accepted only when the upstream registration's own
 -- original row names no satellite, so the walk must terminate at a wallet
 -- entry or resolve nothing. Both registrations are read from
 -- union_pnl_inventory_events (the same first-event provenance as 'reg'); the
 -- live tournament_players row is only the unique (tournament,user) key used
 -- to find them, and a later edit to it can only make this NULL. The upstream
 -- receipts face the identical quality conjunction, byte for byte.
 ), upstream AS (
  SELECT u.tournament_id upstream_id,w.user_id FROM who w
  JOIN public.tournament_players s ON s.tournament_id=w.satellite_id AND s.user_id=w.user_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.after_row r FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
   WHERE e.source_name='tournament_players' AND e.row_id=s.id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 1) sreg
  JOIN public.tournament_players u ON u.tournament_id=(sreg.r->>'source_satellite_id')::uuid AND u.user_id=w.user_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.after_row r FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events e
   WHERE e.source_name='tournament_players' AND e.row_id=u.id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 1) ureg
  WHERE (SELECT e.entries FROM entry e)=0 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM award)=1
   AND sreg.r->>'tournament_id'=w.satellite_id::text AND sreg.r->>'user_id'=w.user_id::text
   AND sreg.r->>'source_satellite_id' IS NOT NULL
   AND ureg.r->>'tournament_id'=sreg.r->>'source_satellite_id' AND ureg.r->>'user_id'=w.user_id::text
   AND ureg.r->>'source_satellite_id' IS NULL
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_satellite_awards a WHERE a.tournament_id=u.tournament_id AND a.user_id=w.user_id)
 ), upstream_entry AS (
  SELECT count(*) n,count(DISTINCT r.funding_club_id) clubs,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.operation='entry') entries,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.asset IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips' OR r.amount IS NULL OR r.amount<=0 OR r.funding_club_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT row.* FROM public.chip_ledger row WHERE row.id=r.ledger_id OFFSET 0) l WHERE l.status='posted' AND l.from_type='player_wallet' AND l.from_entity_id=r.user_id
     AND l.to_type='prize_liability' AND l.to_entity_id=r.tournament_id AND l.tournament_id=r.tournament_id AND l.amount=r.amount
     AND l.club_id=r.funding_club_id AND l.category IN ('tournament_buyin','rebuy','addon') AND l.row_hash IS NOT NULL)) bad
  FROM upstream x JOIN public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.tournament_id=x.upstream_id AND r.user_id=x.user_id
 )
 SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM award)=1 AND e.n>0 AND e.entries>=1 AND e.clubs=1 AND e.bad=0 THEN e.club
  WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM award)=1 AND e.entries=0 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM upstream)=1
   AND x.n>0 AND x.entries>=1 AND x.clubs=1 AND x.bad=0 THEN x.club END
 FROM entry e CROSS JOIN upstream_entry x
$function$

public.fn_union_pnl_week_bbj_stack_award.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_week_bbj_stack_awards(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(club_id uuid, user_id uuid, amount numeric, payout_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH originals AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT q.*,q.ledger_snapshot l,(q.game_scope->>'tournament_id')::uuid tournament_id
 FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients rr JOIN public.bbj_payouts bp ON bp.id=rr.payout_id
 JOIN public.wallet_credit_idempotency wi ON wi.key='bbj:'||bp.id::text||':'||rr.user_id::text
 JOIN public.chip_ledger cl ON cl.idempotency_key=wi.key
 JOIN public.union_pnl_original_flows q ON q.ledger_id=cl.id
 WHERE rr.created_at>=p_start AND rr.created_at<p_end AND q.recognized_at>=p_start AND q.recognized_at<p_end
  AND q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text
 ), bbj_wallet_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  -- The hand's earning club (owner rule 2026-11-15), the credited wallet's
  -- club only where the hand left no attribution.
  SELECT q.ledger_id,COALESCE((SELECT ra.club_id FROM public.rake_attributions ra
    WHERE ra.hand_id=b.hand_id AND ra.player_id=r.user_id AND ra.club_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY ra.created_at DESC,ra.id DESC LIMIT 1),(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid) club_id,r.user_id,r.amount,b.id payout_id
  FROM originals q
  JOIN public.bbj_payouts b ON b.id=CASE WHEN q.l->>'idempotency_key' ~ '^bbj:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN split_part(q.l->>'idempotency_key',':',2)::uuid END
  JOIN public.bbj_payout_recipients r ON r.payout_id=b.id AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid
  JOIN public.wallet_credit_idempotency w ON w.key=q.l->>'idempotency_key' AND w.user_id=r.user_id AND w.amount=r.amount
  JOIN public.bbj_pools pool ON pool.id=b.pool_id
  WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'category'='bbj_payout' AND q.l->>'status'='posted'
   AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet'
   AND q.l->>'from_entity_id'=b.table_id::text AND q.l->>'table_id'=b.table_id::text
   AND q.l->>'id'=q.ledger_id::text AND q.l->>'idempotency_key'='bbj:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text
   AND q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text AND q.game_scope->>'asset'='chips' AND q.game_scope->'unit_scale'='2'::jsonb
   AND (pool.union_id=p_union_id OR (pool.union_id IS NULL AND pool.club_id::text=q.game_scope->>'host_club_id'))
   AND b.kind IN('main','mini') AND b.total_amount>0 AND b.total_amount=round(b.total_amount,2)
   AND b.created_at<=q.recognized_at AND r.created_at=w.created_at AND w.created_at>=b.created_at AND w.created_at<=q.recognized_at
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients unique_recipient WHERE unique_recipient.payout_id=b.id AND unique_recipient.user_id=r.user_id)=1
   AND r.amount=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric AND r.amount>0 AND r.amount=round(r.amount,2)
   AND r.amount::text NOT IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_transactions t WHERE t.transaction_type='bbj_payout' AND t.table_id=b.table_id
     AND t.to_user_id=r.user_id AND t.club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid AND t.amount=r.amount AND t.created_at=w.created_at)=1
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger bank WHERE bank.status='posted' AND bank.category='bbj_payout'
     AND bank.from_type='bbj_pool' AND bank.from_entity_id=b.pool_id AND bank.to_type='table_stack' AND bank.to_entity_id=b.table_id
     AND bank.amount=b.total_amount AND bank.idempotency_key=CASE WHEN b.kind='mini' THEN 'bbj_mini:'||b.pool_id::text||':'||b.table_id::text||':'||b.hand_number::text ELSE 'bbj_payout:'||b.id::text END)=1
   AND (SELECT coalesce(sum(p.amount),0) FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients p WHERE p.payout_id=b.id)
      +(SELECT coalesce(sum(u.amount),0) FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.paid_at IS NULL)=b.total_amount
   AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.user_id=r.user_id)
     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.bbj_unclaimed_shares u WHERE u.payout_id=b.id AND u.user_id=r.user_id AND u.amount=r.amount
       AND u.pool_id=b.pool_id AND u.table_id=b.table_id AND u.paid_at=w.created_at
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger parked WHERE parked.status='posted' AND parked.category='bbj_payout'
         AND parked.from_type='table_stack' AND parked.from_entity_id=b.table_id AND parked.to_type='bbj_pool' AND parked.to_entity_id=b.pool_id
         AND parked.amount=r.amount AND parked.idempotency_key='bbj_park:bbj:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text)=1
       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_ledger redeemed WHERE redeemed.status='posted' AND redeemed.category='bbj_payout'
         AND redeemed.from_type='bbj_pool' AND redeemed.from_entity_id=b.pool_id AND redeemed.to_type='table_stack' AND redeemed.to_entity_id=b.table_id
         AND redeemed.amount=r.amount AND redeemed.idempotency_key='bbj_redeem:'||b.id::text||':'||r.user_id::text)=1)=1)
 )
 SELECT (pp.p->>'earning_club_id')::uuid, r.user_id, r.amount, r.payout_id
 FROM public.bbj_payout_recipients r
 JOIN public.bbj_payouts b ON b.id=r.payout_id
 JOIN public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes o ON o.table_id=b.table_id AND o.hand_number=b.hand_number
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(o.evidence->'participants','[]')) p
  WHERE p->>'user_id'=r.user_id::text LIMIT 1) pp
 WHERE r.created_at>=p_start AND r.created_at<p_end AND r.amount>0
  AND o.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text
  -- a share paid to the wallet of a departed recipient never reached the felt
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.wallet_credit_idempotency w
   WHERE w.key='bbj:'||r.payout_id::text||':'||r.user_id::text)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.chip_ledger wallet_leg WHERE wallet_leg.idempotency_key='bbj:'||r.payout_id::text||':'||r.user_id::text AND wallet_leg.to_type='player_wallet')
 UNION ALL SELECT j.club_id,j.user_id,j.amount,j.payout_id FROM bbj_wallet_matches j
$function$

smarter_private.f06_immutable_identity().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.f06_immutable_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'F06_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='f06_operations' AND (to_jsonb(OLD)->>'state')='withdrawn_before_manifest' THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'F06_WITHDRAWAL_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='f06_hand_permits' AND (to_jsonb(NEW)->>'state')='aborted_unsettled' AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.f06_unsettled_hand_aborts a WHERE a.receipt_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'evidence_id')::uuid
 AND a.permit_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'permit_id')::uuid AND a.tournament_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'tournament_id')::uuid AND a.table_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'table_id')::uuid
 AND a.generation=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'generation')::uuid AND a.hand_number=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'hand_number')::bigint) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.f06_generation_abort_hands a
 WHERE a.receipt_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'evidence_id')::uuid AND a.permit_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'permit_id')::uuid
 AND a.tournament_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'tournament_id')::uuid AND a.table_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'table_id')::uuid
 AND a.generation=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'generation')::uuid AND a.hand_number=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'hand_number')::bigint) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.f06_mixed_abort_hands a
 WHERE a.receipt_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'evidence_id')::uuid AND a.permit_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'permit_id')::uuid
 AND a.tournament_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'tournament_id')::uuid AND a.table_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'table_id')::uuid
 AND a.generation=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'generation')::uuid AND a.hand_number=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'hand_number')::bigint) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.tournament_abort_hand_dispositions a WHERE a.receipt_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'evidence_id')::uuid AND a.permit_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'permit_id')::uuid AND a.tournament_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'tournament_id')::uuid AND a.table_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'table_id')::uuid AND a.generation=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'generation')::uuid AND a.hand_number=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'hand_number')::bigint AND a.original->'permit'=to_jsonb(OLD)) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'F06_ABORT_RECEIPT_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='f06_operations' AND (to_jsonb(NEW)->>'state')='withdrawn_before_manifest' AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.f06_unsettled_hand_aborts a WHERE a.receipt_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'abort_receipt_id')::uuid
 AND a.break_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'break_id')::uuid AND a.tournament_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'tournament_id')::uuid
 AND a.table_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'source_table_id')::uuid AND a.generation=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'origin_generation')::uuid) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.f06_generation_abort_hands a
 WHERE a.receipt_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'abort_receipt_id')::uuid AND a.break_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'break_id')::uuid
 AND a.tournament_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'tournament_id')::uuid AND a.table_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'source_table_id')::uuid
 AND a.generation=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'origin_generation')::uuid) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.f06_mixed_abort_hands a
 WHERE a.receipt_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'abort_receipt_id')::uuid AND a.break_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'break_id')::uuid
 AND a.tournament_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'tournament_id')::uuid AND a.table_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'source_table_id')::uuid
 AND a.generation=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'origin_generation')::uuid) AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.f06_no_start_continuations a
 WHERE a.receipt_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'abort_receipt_id')::uuid
 AND a.break_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'break_id')::uuid
 AND a.tournament_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'tournament_id')::uuid
 AND a.table_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'source_table_id')::uuid
 AND a.original_generation=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'origin_generation')::uuid
 AND a.park=(to_jsonb(OLD))
 AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state'-'abort_receipt_id')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'state'-'abort_receipt_id')) AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.tournament_abort_hand_dispositions a WHERE a.receipt_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'abort_receipt_id')::uuid
 AND a.tournament_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'tournament_id')::uuid AND a.table_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'source_table_id')::uuid
 AND a.original->'parks' @> jsonb_build_array(to_jsonb(OLD)) AND a.boundary->>'closure_mode'='equal_share'
 AND to_jsonb(OLD)->>'state'='park_requested' AND to_jsonb(OLD)->>'revision'='0'
 AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state'-'abort_receipt_id')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'state'-'abort_receipt_id')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'F06_ABORT_RECEIPT_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='f06_hand_permits' AND ((to_jsonb(OLD)-'state'-'evidence_id') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state'-'evidence_id') OR to_jsonb(OLD)->>'state'<>'reserved') THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'F06_HAND_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='f06_members' OR
 (TG_TABLE_NAME='f06_attempts' AND ((to_jsonb(OLD)-'state'-'receipt') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state'-'receipt') OR to_jsonb(OLD)->>'state'<>'active')) OR
 (TG_TABLE_NAME='f06_operations' AND ((to_jsonb(OLD)-'state'-'manifest'-'revision'-'custody_id'-'custody_generation'-'cleanup_kind'-'close_receipt'-'abort_receipt_id') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state'-'manifest'-'revision'-'custody_id'-'custody_generation'-'cleanup_kind'-'close_receipt'-'abort_receipt_id') OR (to_jsonb(OLD)->'manifest'<>'null'::jsonb AND to_jsonb(OLD)->'manifest' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW)->'manifest') OR (to_jsonb(OLD)->'close_receipt'<>'null'::jsonb AND to_jsonb(OLD)->'close_receipt' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW)->'close_receipt'))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'F06_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

smarter_private.hand_submission_immutabl.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.hand_submission_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND TG_TABLE_SCHEMA='smarter_private' AND TG_TABLE_NAME='hand_submissions' THEN
  IF NEW.request IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (OLD.request#-'{p_hand_row,actions}')
  AND OLD.request#>'{p_hand_row,actions}' IS NOT NULL
  AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'request') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM(to_jsonb(OLD)-'request')
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.superseded_horse_action_certificates c
   WHERE c.submission_id=OLD.submission_id AND c.table_id=OLD.table_id AND c.hand_number=OLD.hand_number
    AND c.original_request_sha256=OLD.request_hash
    AND c.original_request_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(OLD.request::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
    AND c.compact_request_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(NEW.request::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
    AND c.immutable_identity_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to((to_jsonb(OLD)-'request')::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'))
  THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF NEW.request='{}'::jsonb AND OLD.request<>'{}'::jsonb
  AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'request') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'request')
  AND smarter_private.horse_request_payload_disposable(OLD.submission_id)
  AND smarter_private.horse_cash_retention_accounting_ready(OLD.table_id,OLD.hand_number)
  AND smarter_private.horse_adaptive_disposal_certificate_matches(OLD.submission_id,OLD.table_id,OLD.hand_number,OLD.request_hash)
  AND smarter_private.horse_stats_basis_matches(OLD.submission_id,OLD.table_id,OLD.hand_number,OLD.request#>'{p_hand_row,_accepted_post_commit_facts,stats_facts}')
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.horse_retained_stats_basis b WHERE b.hand_id=OLD.submission_id AND b.request_hash=OLD.request_hash) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 END IF;
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'HAND_SUBMISSION_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='55000';
END $function$

smarter_private.horse_cash_postprune_cer.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.horse_cash_postprune_certificate_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
AS $function$
DECLARE p public.cash_hand_provenance_receipts; k smarter_private.horse_settlement_key_certificates;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HORSE_CASH_POSTPRUNE_CERTIFICATE_IMMUTABLE'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO p FROM public.cash_hand_provenance_receipts WHERE table_id=NEW.table_id AND hand_number=NEW.hand_number;
 SELECT * INTO k FROM smarter_private.horse_settlement_key_certificates WHERE history_hand_id=p.hand_id;
 IF p.hand_id IS NULL OR (NEW.hand_id,NEW.manifest_id,NEW.accepted_at,NEW.settled_at)
  IS DISTINCT FROM (p.hand_id,p.manifest_id,p.accepted_at,k.settled_at)
 OR NEW.original_boundary_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM smarter_private.horse_cash_retained_boundary_digest(NEW.table_id,NEW.hand_number)
 OR NOT smarter_private.horse_stats_basis_matches(p.hand_id,p.table_id,p.hand_number,p.accepted_request#>'{hand_row,_accepted_post_commit_facts,stats_facts}')
 OR (p.atomic_receipt#>'{post_commit_payload,accepted_hand_facts,stats_facts}' IS NOT NULL
  AND p.atomic_receipt#>'{post_commit_payload,accepted_hand_facts,stats_facts}' IS DISTINCT FROM p.accepted_request#>'{hand_row,_accepted_post_commit_facts,stats_facts}')
 OR NEW.original_request_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM p.payload_hash
 OR NEW.original_request_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p.accepted_request::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
 OR NEW.original_atomic_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p.atomic_receipt::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
 OR NEW.compact_request_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(smarter_private.horse_cash_compact_request(p.accepted_request)::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
 OR NEW.compact_atomic_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(smarter_private.horse_cash_compact_atomic(p.atomic_receipt)::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
 OR NEW.immutable_financial_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to((to_jsonb(p)-ARRAY['accepted_request','atomic_receipt','accepted_at'])::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
 OR NEW.accounting_evidence_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM k.accounting_evidence_sha256 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HORSE_CASH_POSTPRUNE_ORIGINAL_BOUNDARY_REQUIRED'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

smarter_private.horse_fact_retired_cards.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.horse_fact_retired_cards_stay_erased()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Serialize only this hand's admission with its one-time content transition.
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('horse:fact-card-retention:'||NEW.hand_id::text,0));
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.horse_fact_card_disposals d
  JOIN smarter_private.horse_retained_stats_basis b ON b.hand_id=d.hand_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(b.compact_stats->'facts')='array'
   THEN b.compact_stats->'facts' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) original
  WHERE d.hand_id=NEW.hand_id AND original->>'user_id'=NEW.user_id::text)
 THEN NEW.hole_cards:=NULL; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;

smarter_private.original_closed_player_p.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_closed_player_proof(f jsonb, lo timestamp with time zone, hi timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE e jsonb;prior jsonb;b jsonb;t jsonb;c jsonb;refund jsonb;ledger jsonb;wallet jsonb;fund jsonb;
 owner uuid;term jsonb;entry_ledger jsonb;
BEGIN
 e:=f->'event';prior:=f->'prior';b:=e->'before_row';t:=f#>'{parent,after_row}';
 IF f IS NULL OR lo IS NULL OR hi IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(b) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR e->>'source_name' IS DISTINCT FROM 'tournament_players'
 OR jsonb_typeof(prior->'after_row') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR b-ARRAY['status','eliminated_at'] IS DISTINCT FROM (prior->'after_row')-ARRAY['status','eliminated_at']
 OR b->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'eliminated' OR b->>'eliminated_at' IS NULL
 OR (b->>'eliminated_at')::timestamptz NOT BETWEEN '2026-10-06 15:33:00Z' AND '2026-10-06 15:33:10Z'
 OR (prior->>'event_id')::bigint >= (e->>'event_id')::bigint
 OR lo >= (b->>'eliminated_at')::timestamptz OR hi <= (e->>'observed_at')::timestamptz
 OR f#>>'{parent,source_name}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'tournaments'
 OR f#>>'{parent,row_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id' OR t->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id'
 OR f#>>'{parent,observed_at}' IS NULL OR (f#>>'{parent,observed_at}')::timestamptz>=hi
 OR t->>'status' NOT IN('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') OR t->>'status' IS NULL
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_closed_interval_or_value_refused');END IF;
 IF t->>'status'='COMPLETED' THEN
  term:=smarter_private.original_closed_tournament_rails_proof(f->'terminal_fixture',hi);
  IF term->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' OR term->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id'
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_terminal_rails_refused');END IF;
  IF b->>'source_satellite_id' IS NOT NULL THEN
   owner:=public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner((b->>'id')::uuid,(b->>'tournament_id')::uuid);
  ELSE
   IF jsonb_typeof(f->'entry_funding') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(f->'entry_funding')<>1 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_entry_missing');END IF;
   fund:=f#>'{entry_funding,0,receipt}';ledger:=f#>'{entry_funding,0,ledger}';
   IF fund->>'registration_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'id' OR fund->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id'
   OR fund->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id' OR fund->>'asset' IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips'
   OR (fund->>'amount')::numeric IS NULL OR (fund->>'amount')::numeric<=0
   OR fund->>'ledger_id' IS DISTINCT FROM ledger->>'id' OR ledger->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted'
   OR ledger->>'row_hash' IS NULL OR ledger->>'from_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet'
   OR ledger->>'from_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id' OR ledger->>'to_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'prize_liability'
   OR ledger->>'to_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id' OR ledger->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM fund->>'funding_club_id'
   OR (ledger->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (fund->>'amount')::numeric THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_entry_debit_refused');END IF;
   owner:=(fund->>'funding_club_id')::uuid;
  END IF;
  IF owner IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_entry_owner_unproven');END IF;
 ELSE
  c:=f->'cancellation';
  IF jsonb_typeof(c) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR c->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id'
  OR c->'receipt_version' NOT IN('2'::jsonb,'3'::jsonb) OR c->>'receipt_version' IS NULL
  OR c#>'{receipt,ok}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR c#>'{receipt,fully_settled}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR c->>'settled_at' IS NULL OR c->>'escrow_closed_at' IS NULL
  OR (c->>'settled_at')::timestamptz>=hi OR (c->>'escrow_closed_at')::timestamptz>=hi
  OR NOT(c->'refunded_registration_ids' ? (b->>'id')) THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_cancellation_refused');END IF;
  IF jsonb_typeof(f->'entry_funding') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(f->'entry_funding')<>1 THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_cancelled_entry_missing');END IF;
  fund:=f#>'{entry_funding,0,receipt}';entry_ledger:=f#>'{entry_funding,0,ledger}';
  IF fund->>'registration_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'id' OR fund->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id'
  OR fund->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id' OR fund->>'asset' IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips'
  OR (fund->>'amount')::numeric IS NULL OR (fund->>'amount')::numeric<=0
  OR fund->>'ledger_id' IS DISTINCT FROM entry_ledger->>'id' OR entry_ledger->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted'
  OR entry_ledger->>'row_hash' IS NULL OR entry_ledger->>'from_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet'
  OR entry_ledger->>'from_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id' OR entry_ledger->>'to_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'prize_liability'
  OR entry_ledger->>'to_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'tournament_id'
  OR entry_ledger->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM fund->>'funding_club_id'
  OR (entry_ledger->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (fund->>'amount')::numeric THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_cancelled_entry_debit_refused');END IF;
  SELECT r INTO refund FROM jsonb_array_elements(c#>'{receipt,refunds}') r WHERE r->>'registration_id'=b->>'id';
  ledger:=f->'refund_ledger';wallet:=f->'refund_wallet';
  IF refund IS NULL OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(c#>'{receipt,refunds}')r WHERE r->>'registration_id'=b->>'id')<>1
  OR refund->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id' OR refund->>'credit_ledger_id' IS DISTINCT FROM ledger->>'id'
  OR refund->>'source_wallet_club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM fund->>'funding_club_id'
  OR refund->>'entitlement_id' IS DISTINCT FROM fund->>'entitlement_id'
  OR (refund->>'gross_paid')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (fund->>'amount')::numeric
  OR refund->>'wallet_transaction_id' IS DISTINCT FROM wallet->>'id'
  OR ledger->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted' OR ledger->>'row_hash' IS NULL
  OR ledger->>'to_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet' OR ledger->>'to_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id'
  OR ledger->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM refund->>'source_wallet_club_id'
  OR (ledger->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (refund->>'amount_paid_now')::numeric
  OR (wallet->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (refund->>'amount_paid_now')::numeric
  OR wallet->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'user_id' OR wallet->>'type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'credit'
  OR (refund->>'amount_paid_before')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM 0
  OR (refund->>'amount_paid_now')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (refund->>'gross_paid')::numeric
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_refund_delivery_refused');END IF;
  owner:=(refund->>'source_wallet_club_id')::uuid;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','ready','financial_admission',false,'event_id',e->'event_id','source_name','tournament_players',
 'original_owner',owner,'original_closed_held',0,'original_state_hashes_preserved',true,'missing_force_event_invented',false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','malformed_original');
END $function$

smarter_private.original_closed_tourname.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_closed_tournament_rails_proof(f jsonb, hi timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE terminal jsonb;pay jsonb;credit jsonb;ledger jsonb;amount numeric;total numeric:=0;n integer:=0;
BEGIN
 terminal:=f->'terminal';
 IF f IS NULL OR hi IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(terminal) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR terminal->'receipt_version' NOT IN('2'::jsonb,'3'::jsonb)
 OR terminal->>'receipt_version' IS NULL OR terminal->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'tournament_id'
 OR terminal->>'accounting_state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'recognized'
 OR terminal#>'{cash_receipt,fully_settled}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
 OR terminal#>'{cash_receipt,ok}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
 OR terminal->>'completed_at' IS NULL OR terminal->>'settled_at' IS NULL OR terminal->>'escrow_closed_at' IS NULL
 OR (terminal->>'completed_at')::timestamptz>=hi OR (terminal->>'settled_at')::timestamptz>=hi
 OR (terminal->>'escrow_closed_at')::timestamptz>=hi
 OR jsonb_typeof(f->'payouts') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_typeof(f->'credits') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(f->'ledgers') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_array_length(f->'payouts') IS DISTINCT FROM (terminal->>'cash_payout_count')::integer
 OR jsonb_array_length(f->'payouts') IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(f->'credits')
 OR jsonb_array_length(f->'payouts') IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(f->'ledgers')
 OR f->'diamond_rail_count' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'::jsonb OR f->'satellite_rail_count' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'::jsonb
 OR (terminal->>'cash_payout_total')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (terminal->>'prize_pool')::numeric
 OR (terminal->>'bounty_payout_total')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (terminal->>'bounty_pool')::numeric
 OR (terminal->>'bounty_pool')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM 0
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_terminal_or_asset_refused');END IF;
 FOR pay IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(f->'payouts') LOOP
  amount:=(pay->>'amount')::numeric;
  IF amount IS NULL OR amount<=0 OR amount*100<>trunc(amount*100)
  OR pay->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'tournament_id'
  OR pay->>'paid_at' IS NULL OR (pay->>'paid_at')::timestamptz>=hi
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(terminal#>'{cash_receipt,payouts}') p
   WHERE p->>'user_id'=pay->>'user_id' AND (p->>'amount')::numeric=amount)
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_payout_refused');END IF;
  SELECT c INTO credit FROM jsonb_array_elements(f->'credits') c
  WHERE c->>'user_id'=pay->>'user_id' AND c->>'tournament_id'=f->>'tournament_id' AND (c->>'amount')::numeric=amount;
  IF credit IS NULL OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(f->'credits') c
   WHERE c->>'user_id'=pay->>'user_id' AND c->>'tournament_id'=f->>'tournament_id' AND (c->>'amount')::numeric=amount)<>1
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_credit_ambiguous');END IF;
  SELECT l INTO ledger FROM jsonb_array_elements(f->'ledgers')l WHERE l->>'id'=credit->>'ledger_id';
  IF ledger IS NULL OR ledger->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted' OR ledger->>'row_hash' IS NULL
  OR ledger->>'from_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'prize_liability' OR ledger->>'from_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'tournament_id'
  OR ledger->>'to_type' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet' OR ledger->>'to_entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM pay->>'user_id'
  OR ledger->>'category' IS DISTINCT FROM 'tournament_prize' OR (ledger->>'amount')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM amount
  OR ledger->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM credit->>'credited_club_id'
  OR ledger->>'created_at' IS NULL OR (ledger->>'created_at')::timestamptz>=hi
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_posted_prize_refused');END IF;
  total:=total+amount;n:=n+1;
 END LOOP;
 IF total IS DISTINCT FROM (terminal->>'cash_payout_total')::numeric THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_pool_not_conserved');END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','ready','financial_admission',false,'tournament_id',f->'tournament_id',
 'original_prize_rows',n,'original_pool',total,'all_actual_rails_checked',true,'raw_history_rewritten',false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','malformed_original');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_continued_chair_proof(f jsonb, lo timestamp with time zone, hi timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE e jsonb;p jsonb;b jsonb;a jsonb;tp jsonb;proved jsonb;authority jsonb;expected jsonb;original_row jsonb;
BEGIN
 e:=f->'event';p:=f->'prior';b:=e->'before_row';a:=e->'after_row';tp:=f#>'{player,event,before_row}';
 authority:=f->'authority';
 proved:=smarter_private.original_closed_player_proof(f->'player',lo,hi);
 IF proved->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' OR f IS NULL
 OR jsonb_typeof(b) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(a) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(p->'after_row') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR e->>'source_name' IS DISTINCT FROM 'table_seats'
 OR e->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'UPDATE' OR b-'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM (p->'after_row')-'left_at'
 OR p#>'{after_row,left_at}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR b->>'left_at' IS NULL
 OR a-ARRAY['left_at','joined_at','occupancy_id'] IS DISTINCT FROM b-ARRAY['left_at','joined_at','occupancy_id']
 OR a->'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR a->>'occupancy_id' IS NULL OR a->>'occupancy_id'=b->>'occupancy_id'
 OR a->>'joined_at' IS NULL OR (a->>'joined_at')::timestamptz<=(b->>'left_at')::timestamptz
 OR (a->>'joined_at')::timestamptz>=hi OR hi<=(e->>'observed_at')::timestamptz
 OR b->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM tp->>'user_id'
 OR b->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM authority->>'table_id'
 OR b->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM authority->>'seat_id' OR b->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM authority->>'user_id'
 OR tp->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM authority->>'registration_id' OR tp->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM authority->>'tournament_id'
 OR (b->>'stack')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (authority->>'starting_stack')::numeric OR (b->>'stack')::numeric<=0
 OR NOT(f#>'{player,terminal_fixture,terminal,source_seat_ids}' ? (b->>'id'))
 OR NOT(f#>'{player,terminal_fixture,terminal,closed_table_ids}' ? (b->>'table_id'))
 OR e->>'transaction_id' IS DISTINCT FROM f#>>'{player,event,transaction_id}'
 OR (p->>'event_id')::bigint >= (e->>'event_id')::bigint
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_native_chair_refused');END IF;
 IF authority->>'class'='undealt_paid_entry' THEN
  IF authority->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM '20261007024455' OR authority->>'source_md5' IS DISTINCT FROM '71c1904782272e10246d056862447ea8'
  OR f#>>'{restoration,transaction_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM e->>'transaction_id'
  OR f#>>'{restoration,qualification_hash}' IS DISTINCT FROM md5((f->>'expected_raw')::jsonb::text)
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_undealt_qualification_refused');END IF;
  expected:=(f->>'expected_raw')::jsonb;
  SELECT x INTO original_row FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected->'rows')x WHERE x#>>'{seat,id}'=b->>'id';
  IF original_row IS NULL OR original_row#>>'{roster,id}' IS DISTINCT FROM tp->>'id'
  OR original_row#>>'{seat,occupancy_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'occupancy_id'
  OR (original_row#>>'{seat,stack}')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (b->>'stack')::numeric
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(f#>'{restoration,native_results}')r WHERE r->>'seat_id'=b->>'id'
   AND r->>'table_id'=b->>'table_id' AND r->>'user_id'=b->>'user_id' AND r->'ok'='true'::jsonb
   AND r->'replayed'='false'::jsonb AND (r->>'stack')::numeric=(b->>'stack')::numeric)
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_undealt_native_assignment_refused');END IF;
 ELSIF authority->>'class'='original_four_spin' THEN
  IF authority->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM '20261007132839' OR authority->>'source_md5' IS DISTINCT FROM 'f99c99c31d0aedac3466e106714c4fb5' THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_spin_source_refused');END IF;
 ELSE RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','unknown_original_assignment');END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','ready','financial_admission',false,'event_id',e->'event_id',
 'original_paid_entry_reproved',true,'original_owner',proved->'original_owner','original_stack_unchanged',true,'original_closed_held',0,
 'missing_force_event_invented',false,'raw_history_rewritten',false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','malformed_original');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_erased_cash_base_proof(f jsonb, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE e jsonb;prior jsonb;s jsonb;mp jsonb;delta numeric;base numeric;fund jsonb;clubs text[];a jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF f IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(f) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR p_at IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','missing_original');END IF;
 e:=f->'event';prior:=f->'prior';s:=f->'signed';mp:=f->'participant';a:=f->'atomic';
 IF e->>'source_name' IS DISTINCT FROM 'table_seats' OR e->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DELETE'
 OR e->'after_row' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(e->'before_row') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(prior->'after_row') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR (e->'before_row')-'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM (prior->'after_row')-'left_at'
 OR prior#>'{after_row,left_at}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
 OR e#>>'{before_row,left_at}' IS NULL
 OR (e#>>'{before_row,left_at}')::timestamptz NOT BETWEEN '2026-10-06 15:33:00Z' AND '2026-10-06 15:33:10Z'
 OR (prior->>'event_id')::bigint >= (e->>'event_id')::bigint
 OR p_at <= (e->>'observed_at')::timestamptz
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_transition_or_boundary_refused');END IF;
 IF s->>'seat_id' IS DISTINCT FROM e->>'row_id' OR s->>'seat_id' IS DISTINCT FROM e#>>'{before_row,id}'
 OR s->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM e#>>'{before_row,user_id}'
 OR s->>'occupancy_id' IS DISTINCT FROM e#>>'{before_row,occupancy_id}'
 OR (s->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (e#>>'{before_row,joined_at}')::timestamptz
 OR jsonb_typeof(s->'stack_before') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR jsonb_typeof(s->'stack') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR jsonb_typeof(e#>'{before_row,stack}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR (s->>'stack_before')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (e#>>'{before_row,stack}')::numeric
 OR (s->>'stack_before')::numeric<=0 OR (s->>'stack')::numeric<0
 OR (s->>'stack_before')::numeric*100<>trunc((s->>'stack_before')::numeric*100)
 OR (s->>'stack')::numeric*100<>trunc((s->>'stack')::numeric*100)
 OR mp->>'seat_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'seat_id' OR mp->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'user_id'
 OR mp->>'occupancy_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'occupancy_id'
 OR (mp->>'stack_before')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (s->>'stack_before')::numeric
 OR mp#>'{funding_lineage,issues}' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
 OR jsonb_typeof(f->'funding') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(f->'funding')=0
 OR jsonb_typeof(mp->'funding_receipts') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_array_length(mp->'funding_receipts') IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(f->'funding')
 OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x#>>'{receipt,id}') FROM jsonb_array_elements(f->'funding')x) IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(f->'funding')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(mp->'funding_receipts') r WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(f->'funding') x WHERE x#>>'{receipt,id}'=r->>'id'))
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_identity_stack_or_funding_refused');END IF;
 base:=(s->>'stack_before')::numeric;delta:=(s->>'stack')::numeric-base;
 IF a->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM e#>>'{before_row,table_id}'
 OR a#>>'{stack_result,success}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
 OR a#>>'{stack_result,conservation_checked}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
 OR a#>>'{post_commit_result,ok}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' OR a->>'post_commit_completed_at' IS NULL
 OR (a->>'post_commit_completed_at')::timestamptz >= p_at
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(a#>'{stack_result,departed}') d
 WHERE d->>'seat_id'=s->>'seat_id' AND d->>'user_id'=s->>'user_id' AND (d->>'delta')::numeric=delta)
 OR jsonb_typeof(f->'late_ledger') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR f#>>'{late_ledger,idempotency_key}' IS DISTINCT FROM f->>'late_key'
 OR (f#>>'{late_ledger,amount}')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM abs(delta)
 OR f#>>'{late_ledger,category}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'settlement'
 OR f->>'late_key' IS DISTINCT FROM 'late_seat_settle:'||(a#>>'{stack_result,hand_id}')||':'||(s->>'user_id')
 OR (CASE WHEN delta>0 THEN f#>>'{late_ledger,from_type}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'table_stack'
 OR f#>>'{late_ledger,from_entity_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'table_id'
 OR f#>>'{late_ledger,to_type}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet' OR f#>>'{late_ledger,to_entity_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'user_id'
 ELSE f#>>'{late_ledger,from_type}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet' OR f#>>'{late_ledger,from_entity_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'user_id'
 OR f#>>'{late_ledger,to_type}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'table_stack' OR f#>>'{late_ledger,to_entity_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'table_id' END)
 OR f#>>'{late_idempotency,user_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'user_id'
 OR (f#>>'{late_idempotency,amount}')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM delta
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','completed_original_delta_refused');END IF;
 FOR fund IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(f->'funding') LOOP
  IF fund#>>'{receipt,asset}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips' OR fund#>>'{receipt,account_type}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet'
  OR fund#>>'{receipt,user_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'user_id' OR fund#>>'{receipt,account_entity_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'user_id'
  OR fund#>>'{receipt,table_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'table_id' OR fund#>>'{receipt,occupancy_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'occupancy_id'
  OR fund#>>'{receipt,source_ledger_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM fund#>>'{ledger,id}'
  OR fund#>>'{receipt,wallet_transaction_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM fund#>>'{debit,id}'
  OR fund#>>'{ledger,from_type}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet' OR fund#>>'{ledger,from_entity_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'user_id'
  OR fund#>>'{debit,type}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'debit' OR fund#>>'{debit,user_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'user_id'
  OR (fund#>>'{receipt,amount}')::numeric IS NULL OR (fund#>>'{receipt,amount}')::numeric<=0
  OR (fund#>>'{receipt,amount}')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (fund#>>'{ledger,amount}')::numeric
  OR (fund#>>'{receipt,amount}')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (fund#>>'{debit,amount}')::numeric
  OR fund#>>'{receipt,funding_club_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM fund#>>'{ledger,club_id}'
  THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_debit_refused');END IF;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT x#>>'{receipt,funding_club_id}') INTO clubs FROM jsonb_array_elements(f->'funding') x;
 IF cardinality(clubs) IS DISTINCT FROM 1 OR clubs[1] IS NULL OR f#>>'{late_ledger,club_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM clubs[1]
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_owner_refused');END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','ready','financial_admission',false,'boundary',p_at,'original_base',base,'preserved_played_delta',delta,
 'holding',jsonb_build_object('kind','original_erased_cash_receivable','source_id',s->>'occupancy_id','user_id',s->>'user_id','club_id',clubs[1],'amount',base),
 'raw_issue_event_id',e->'event_id','missing_force_event_invented',false,'current_membership_used',false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR datetime_field_overflow OR invalid_datetime_format OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','malformed_original');
END $function$

smarter_private.original_lightning_fundi.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_lightning_funding_owner_evidence(p_table uuid, p_number bigint, p_scope jsonb, p_evidence jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET enable_nestloop TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE started timestamptz; lightning_id uuid; person jsonb; custody record;
 occupancy uuid; funding uuid; funding_count bigint; original_union boolean;
 result_people jsonb:='[]'::jsonb; game_union uuid;
BEGIN
 game_union:=(p_scope->>'game_union_id')::uuid;
 -- Already-correct owners and other original custody shapes retain exact bytes.
 IF game_union IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_evidence->'participants')q
  WHERE q->>'ownership_scope'='original_lightning_pool_session'AND q->>'earning_club_id'=game_union::text)
 THEN RETURN p_evidence;END IF;
 SELECT h.hand_id,hh.started_at INTO STRICT lightning_id,started
 FROM public.lightning_hand h JOIN public.hand_history hh ON hh.id=h.hand_history_id
 WHERE h.host_table_id=p_table AND h.hand_number=p_number AND hh.table_id=p_table AND hh.hand_number=p_number
  AND hh.id::text=p_evidence->>'hand_id';
 IF started IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(started) OR p_evidence->>'table_id'IS DISTINCT FROM p_table::text
  OR p_evidence->>'hand_number'IS DISTINCT FROM p_number::text OR p_evidence->'game_scope'IS DISTINCT FROM p_scope
  OR p_evidence->>'status'IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready'OR p_evidence->'basis_certified'IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_lightning_funding_owner_identity_changed';END IF;
 FOR person IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_evidence->'participants')LOOP
  IF person->>'ownership_scope'='original_lightning_pool_session'AND person->>'earning_club_id'=game_union::text THEN
   SELECT hp.net_result,cs.id cash_session,cs.club_id,cs.table_id,cs.opened_at,cs.closed_at,ps.anchor_seat_id,
    ps.entered_at,ps.exited_at,sl.opened_at slot_opened,sl.closed_at slot_closed
   INTO STRICT custody FROM public.lightning_hand_player hp
   JOIN public.lightning_pool_slot sl ON sl.id=hp.pool_slot_id AND sl.player_id=hp.player_id
    AND sl.id=(person->>'pool_slot_id')::uuid
   JOIN public.lightning_pool_session ps ON ps.id=sl.pool_session_id AND ps.player_id=hp.player_id
    AND ps.id=(person->>'pool_session_id')::uuid AND ps.cluster_id=sl.cluster_id AND ps.cluster_epoch=sl.cluster_epoch
   JOIN public.cash_player_session cs ON cs.id=ps.cash_player_session_id AND cs.player_id=hp.player_id
   WHERE hp.hand_id=lightning_id AND hp.player_id=(person->>'user_id')::uuid
    AND hp.cluster_id=sl.cluster_id AND hp.cluster_epoch=sl.cluster_epoch;
   IF person->'original_funding_session_ids'IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(custody.cash_session)
    OR person->'ownership_certified'IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR custody.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM game_union
    OR (person->>'observed_stack_delta')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM custody.net_result
    OR custody.opened_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(custody.opened_at)OR custody.opened_at>started
    OR(custody.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND(NOT isfinite(custody.closed_at)OR custody.closed_at<=started))
    OR custody.entered_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(custody.entered_at)OR custody.entered_at>started
    OR(custody.exited_at IS NOT NULL AND(NOT isfinite(custody.exited_at)OR custody.exited_at<=started))
    OR custody.slot_opened IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(custody.slot_opened)OR custody.slot_opened>started
    OR(custody.slot_closed IS NOT NULL AND(NOT isfinite(custody.slot_closed)OR custody.slot_closed<=started))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_lightning_funding_owner_custody_changed';END IF;
   occupancy:=NULL;funding:=NULL;funding_count:=NULL;
   -- Same original Nov1 anchor-first rule, then the carried-stack fallback.
   SELECT r.occupancy_id INTO occupancy FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r
   WHERE r.table_id=custody.table_id AND r.account_entity_id=(person->>'user_id')::uuid
    AND r.operation_kind='buyin'AND r.user_id=(person->>'user_id')::uuid
    AND r.seat_id=custody.anchor_seat_id AND r.recorded_at<=started
   ORDER BY r.recorded_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT 1;
   IF occupancy IS NULL THEN
    SELECT r.occupancy_id INTO occupancy FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r
    WHERE r.user_id=(person->>'user_id')::uuid AND r.account_entity_id=(person->>'user_id')::uuid
     AND r.operation_kind='buyin'AND r.recorded_at<=started
    ORDER BY r.recorded_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT 1;
   END IF;
   IF occupancy IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT count(DISTINCT r.funding_club_id),min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid,
     bool_and(r.funding_union_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM game_union AND r.asset IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'chips'AND r.user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (person->>'user_id')::uuid)
    INTO funding_count,funding,original_union FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r
    WHERE r.occupancy_id=occupancy AND r.recorded_at<=started AND r.funding_club_id IS NOT NULL;
    -- Receipt-time union attribution is immutable; current membership cannot
    -- rewrite a closed week's original funding ownership.
    IF funding_count=1 AND funding IS DISTINCT FROM custody.club_id AND original_union IS TRUE THEN
     person:=jsonb_set(person,'{earning_club_id}',to_jsonb(funding));
    END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;
  result_people:=result_people||jsonb_build_array(person);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN jsonb_set(p_evidence,'{participants}',result_people);
END $function$

smarter_private.original_paired_seat_res.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_paired_seat_restoration_proof(f jsonb, tp jsonb, lo timestamp with time zone, hi timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE ready jsonb;b jsonb;p jsonb;a jsonb;q jsonb;
BEGIN
 ready:=smarter_private.original_retirement_boundary_proof(tp,lo,hi);
 IF ready->'ready' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','original_hand_refused');END IF;
 b:=f#>'{next,before_row}';p:=f#>'{prior,after_row}';a:=f#>'{next,after_row}';q:=f#>'{qualification,row}';
 IF f IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(b) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(p) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(a) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR b-'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM p-'left_at' OR p->'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
 OR a-'left_at'-'occupancy_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b-'left_at'-'occupancy_id'
 OR a->'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR a->>'occupancy_id' IS NULL
 OR a->>'occupancy_id'=b->>'occupancy_id'
 OR f#>>'{next,transaction_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM tp#>>'{restoration,transaction_id}'
 OR f->'qualification' IS DISTINCT FROM tp->'qualification'
 OR b->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM q#>>'{seat,id}' OR b->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM q->>'user_id'
 OR b->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM tp#>>'{qualification,table_id}'
 OR b->>'left_at' IS DISTINCT FROM q#>>'{seat,left_at}'
 OR (b->>'stack')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (q#>>'{stack,stack_before}')::numeric
 OR (b->>'joined_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (q#>>'{seat,joined_at}')::timestamptz
 OR b->>'occupancy_id' IS DISTINCT FROM q#>>'{seat,occupancy_id}'
 OR (f#>>'{prior,event_id}')::bigint >= (f#>>'{next,event_id}')::bigint
 OR lo>=(b->>'left_at')::timestamptz OR hi<=(f#>>'{next,observed_at}')::timestamptz
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','exact_original_seat_or_interval_refused');END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','ready','financial_admission',false,'source_name','table_seats','event_id',f#>'{next,event_id}',
 'original_monetary_stack_unchanged',true,'signed_original_hand_preserved',true,'raw_history_rewritten',false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','blocked','reason','malformed_original');
END $function$

smarter_private.original_retirement_boun.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_retirement_boundary_proof(f jsonb, lo timestamp with time zone, hi timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 a jsonb:=f#>'{prior,after_row}'; b jsonb:=f#>'{next,before_row}';
 z jsonb:=f#>'{next,after_row}'; q jsonb:=f->'qualification';
 r jsonb:=f->'restoration'; s jsonb:=f#>'{retained,original_submission}';
 roster jsonb:=q#>'{row,roster}'; seat jsonb:=q#>'{row,seat}';
 original_stack jsonb:=q#>'{row,stack}'; t timestamptz;
 committed jsonb:=f->'atomic_commit';
BEGIN
 IF f IS NULL OR lo IS NULL OR hi IS NULL OR lo>=hi OR a IS NULL OR b IS NULL OR z IS NULL
 OR q IS NULL OR r IS NULL OR s IS NULL OR roster IS NULL OR seat IS NULL OR original_stack IS NULL OR committed IS NULL THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','missing_original_witness');
 END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(f) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(a) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(b) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(z) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(q) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(r) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(s) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(roster) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(seat) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(original_stack) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR jsonb_typeof(committed) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','malformed_original_structure');
 END IF;
 IF committed->>'hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM q->>'submission_id'
 OR committed->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM q->>'table_id'
 OR committed->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM q->>'hand_number'
 OR committed->'post_commit_completed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
 OR committed->>'post_commit_ok' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
 OR committed->>'row_md5' IS NULL OR committed->>'row_md5' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$' THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','original_atomic_completion_unproven');
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(q) e WHERE e.value='null'::jsonb)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(r) e WHERE e.value='null'::jsonb)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(s) e WHERE e.value='null'::jsonb)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['id','user_id','tournament_id','club_id']) k
    WHERE nullif(a->>k,'') IS NULL)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['id','user_id','club_id','table_id','occupancy_id','joined_at']) k
    WHERE nullif(seat->>k,'') IS NULL)
 OR f#>>'{prior,event_id}' IS NULL OR f#>>'{next,event_id}' IS NULL
 OR f#>>'{prior,observed_at}' IS NULL OR f#>>'{next,observed_at}' IS NULL
 OR f#>>'{next,transaction_id}' IS NULL THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','null_original_authority');
 END IF;
 IF NOT(a ?& ARRAY['id','user_id','tournament_id','club_id','prize','bounty_winnings','status','eliminated_at'])
 OR NOT(roster ?& ARRAY['id','user_id','tournament_id','chips','position','prize','status','eliminated_at'])
 OR NOT(seat ?& ARRAY['id','user_id','club_id','table_id','occupancy_id','stack','joined_at'])
 OR NOT(original_stack ?& ARRAY['seat_id','user_id','seat_joined_at','stack_before'])
 OR jsonb_typeof(roster->'chips') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR jsonb_typeof(seat->'stack') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR jsonb_typeof(original_stack->'stack_before') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR NOT(q ?& ARRAY['submission_id','table_id','tournament_id','hand_number','request_hash','qualification_hash'])
 OR NOT(r ?& ARRAY['submission_id','request_hash','qualification_hash','original_generation','successor_generation','transaction_id','restored_at','restored_players'])
 OR NOT(s ?& ARRAY['submission_id','request_hash','table_id','hand_number','lease_generation','stacks','started_at'])
 OR jsonb_typeof(f#>'{retained,expected,rows}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(s->'stacks') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','missing_original_field');
 END IF;
 t:=(b->>'eliminated_at')::timestamptz;
 -- The interval endpoints may never cross the unrecorded transient state.
 IF t IS NULL OR NOT(lo<t AND greatest((r->>'restored_at')::timestamptz,(f#>>'{next,observed_at}')::timestamptz)<hi)
 OR NOT((f#>>'{prior,observed_at}')::timestamptz<t AND t<(r->>'restored_at')::timestamptz
 AND t<(f#>>'{next,observed_at}')::timestamptz)
 OR (f#>>'{prior,event_id}')::bigint>=(f#>>'{next,event_id}')::bigint THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','boundary_or_chronology_unproven');
 END IF;
 IF a IS DISTINCT FROM z OR (a-ARRAY['status','eliminated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (b-ARRAY['status','eliminated_at'])
 OR a->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'playing' OR a->'eliminated_at' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
 OR b->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'eliminated' OR (a->>'prize')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM 0
 OR (a->>'bounty_winnings')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM (roster->>'bounty_winnings')::numeric
 OR (a->>'id',a->>'user_id',a->>'tournament_id') IS DISTINCT FROM
    (roster->>'id',roster->>'user_id',roster->>'tournament_id')
 OR roster->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'status' OR roster->>'eliminated_at' IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'eliminated_at'
 OR roster->'position' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR (roster->>'prize')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM 0
 OR (roster->>'chips')::numeric<=0 OR roster->>'chips' IS DISTINCT FROM seat->>'stack'
 OR roster->>'chips' IS DISTINCT FROM original_stack->>'stack_before'
 OR original_stack->>'seat_id' IS DISTINCT FROM seat->>'id'
 OR original_stack->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'user_id'
 OR original_stack->>'seat_joined_at' IS DISTINCT FROM seat->>'joined_at'
 OR seat->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'user_id' OR seat->>'club_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'club_id'
 OR seat->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM q->>'table_id' OR seat->>'occupancy_id' IS NULL THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','original_value_or_ownership_changed');
 END IF;
 IF q->>'submission_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r->>'submission_id'
 OR q->>'submission_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'submission_id'
 OR q->>'request_hash' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'request_hash'
 OR q->>'request_hash' IS DISTINCT FROM r->>'request_hash'
 OR q->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'table_id' OR q->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'hand_number'
 OR q->>'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a->>'tournament_id'
 OR r->>'original_generation' IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'lease_generation'
 OR r->>'successor_generation' IS NULL OR r->>'successor_generation'=r->>'original_generation'
 OR r->>'transaction_id' IS DISTINCT FROM f#>>'{next,transaction_id}'
 OR q->>'qualification_hash' IS DISTINCT FROM r->>'qualification_hash'
 OR md5((f#>'{retained,expected}')::text) IS DISTINCT FROM r->>'qualification_hash'
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(f#>'{retained,expected,rows}') e WHERE e=q->'row')<>1
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(s->'stacks') e WHERE e=original_stack)<>1
 OR (r->>'restored_players')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(f#>'{retained,expected,rows}')
 OR NOT((s->>'started_at')::timestamptz<greatest((r->>'restored_at')::timestamptz,(f#>>'{next,observed_at}')::timestamptz))
 OR NOT(t BETWEEN '2026-10-06 15:33:04Z'::timestamptz AND '2026-10-06 15:33:08Z'::timestamptz) THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','original_restoration_not_bound');
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',true,'proof_class','original_tournament_restoration_cycle',
 'financial_admission',false,'original_force_transaction','not_retained',
 'prior_event',f#>'{prior,event_id}','restoration_event',f#>'{next,event_id}',
 'original_row_hash',md5(a::text),'forced_row_hash',md5(b::text),
 'original_qualification_hash',r->>'qualification_hash','from',lo,'until',hi);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR datetime_field_overflow THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready',false,'reason','malformed_original_witness');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.original_treasury_participant_gift(p_participant jsonb, p_table uuid, p_captured timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER

 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$

BEGIN
 SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(v)->0 INTO n,g FROM smarter_private.original_treasury_funding_witnesses w

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.posthand_escrow_original_snapshot(p_table uuid, p_number bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'smarter_private'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE a public.hand_atomic_commits;p public.cash_hand_provenance_receipts;o public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes;proof jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM public.hand_atomic_commits WHERE table_id=p_table AND hand_number=p_number;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM public.cash_hand_provenance_receipts WHERE table_id=p_table AND hand_number=p_number;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT o FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes WHERE table_id=p_table AND hand_number=p_number;
 proof:=public.fn_union_pnl_prove_posthand_escrow(p_table,p_number);
 IF proof->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'proven' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'POSTHAND_ESCROW_ORIGINAL_UNPROVEN' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('version',1,'table_id',p_table,'hand_number',p_number,'hand_id',a.hand_id,
  'manifest_id',p.manifest_id,'accepted_at',p.accepted_at,'source_financial_request_sha256',p.payload_hash,
  'original_accounting_evidence_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(o.evidence::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'qualified_evidence_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(smarter_private.posthand_escrow_project_evidence(o.evidence,proof)::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'original_participant_roster_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p.participants::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'immutable_financial_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to((to_jsonb(p)-ARRAY['accepted_request','atomic_receipt','accepted_at'])::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'original_atomic_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p.atomic_receipt::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'compact_atomic_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(smarter_private.horse_cash_compact_atomic(p.atomic_receipt)::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'stack_hand_id',a.stack_result->>'hand_id',
  'original_stack_result_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(a.stack_result::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'original_stack_request_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to((a.stack_result->'request')::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'committed_at',a.committed_at,'completed_at',a.post_commit_completed_at,
  'postcommit_payload_sha256',a.post_commit_payload_hash,'postcommit_request_sha256',a.post_commit_request_hash,
  'postcommit_result_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(a.post_commit_result::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'pending_ids',a.post_commit_payload#>'{pending_addons,ids}',
  'proof',proof);
END $function$

smarter_private.rakeback_wallet_payout_c.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.rakeback_wallet_payout_complete(p_payout uuid, p_calculation bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE pp public.rakeback_period_payouts%ROWTYPE;c public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT*INTO pp FROM public.rakeback_period_payouts WHERE id=p_payout;
 SELECT*INTO c FROM public.accounting_rakeback_period_calculations WHERE id=p_calculation;
 IF pp.id IS NULL OR c.id IS NULL OR pp.status IS DISTINCT FROM'paid'OR pp.rakeback_period_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id OR pp.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.club_id OR pp.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR pp.payout_amount IS DISTINCT FROM c.rakeback_amount
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.rakeback_periods r WHERE r.id=c.period_id AND r.status='paid')
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.accounting_rakeback_wallet_contracts w WHERE w.calculation_id=c.id AND w.destination_kind='agent_wallet')THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*)FROM public.accounting_rakeback_wallet_transfers t WHERE t.payout_id=pp.id)<>(SELECT count(*)FROM smarter_private.rakeback_certificate_wallets(c.id)g WHERE g.owed>0)THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 RETURN NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT FROM smarter_private.rakeback_certificate_wallets(c.id)g
 LEFT JOIN public.accounting_rakeback_wallet_transfers t ON t.payout_id=pp.id AND t.payer_kind=g.payer_kind AND t.payer_entity_id=g.payer_entity AND t.destination_kind=g.destination_kind
 LEFT JOIN public.chip_ledger l ON l.id=t.ledger_id LEFT JOIN public.wallet_transactions w ON w.id=t.wallet_transaction_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT coalesce(l.metadata->>'cascade_route'='owner_wallet'AND smarter_private.rakeback_cascade_owner_leg_paid(l.id,c.club_id,g.payer_kind,g.payer_user),false) ok)routed
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT CASE WHEN routed.ok THEN'agent_wallet'WHEN g.payer_kind='club'OR g.payer_user IS NULL OR(l.from_type='club_treasury'AND l.metadata->>'owner_share_payer'=g.payer_user::text)THEN'club_treasury'ELSE'agent_wallet'END kind)funded
 WHERE g.owed>0 AND(t.payout_id IS NULL OR t.calculation_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.id OR t.period_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id OR t.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed
 OR l.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR l.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.club_id OR l.from_type IS DISTINCT FROM funded.kind OR l.from_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN routed.ok THEN(l.metadata->>'cascade_owner')::uuid WHEN funded.kind='club_treasury'THEN c.club_id ELSE g.payer_user END
 OR l.to_type IS DISTINCT FROM g.destination_kind OR l.to_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR l.category IS DISTINCT FROM'rakeback'OR l.status IS DISTINCT FROM'posted'
 OR l.idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM'round3-period:own-agent-v1:'||c.period_id||':payer:'||g.payer_kind||':'||g.payer_entity||':destination:'||g.destination_kind
 OR l.metadata?'certificate_kind'OR l.metadata->>'routing_version'IS DISTINCT FROM'3'
 OR l.metadata->>'accounting_scope_kind'IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN c.coordinator_union_id IS NULL THEN'club'ELSE'union'END
 OR l.metadata->>'accounting_scope_id'IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(c.coordinator_union_id,c.club_id)::text
 OR(l.metadata->>'period_start')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM(c.period_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE'America/Los_Angeles')
 OR(l.metadata->>'period_end')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM((c.period_end+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE'America/Los_Angeles')
 OR l.metadata->>'wallet_transaction_id'IS DISTINCT FROM t.wallet_transaction_id::text
 OR l.metadata->>'paid_from'IS DISTINCT FROM funded.kind
 OR l.metadata->>'payee_role_at_transfer'IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN g.destination_kind='agent_wallet'THEN'agent'ELSE'player'END
 OR l.metadata->>'wallet_destination_version'IS DISTINCT FROM'own-agent-v1'OR l.metadata->>'destination_kind'IS DISTINCT FROM g.destination_kind
 OR l.metadata->>'certificate_id'IS DISTINCT FROM c.id::text OR l.metadata->>'payout_id'IS DISTINCT FROM pp.id::text OR l.metadata->>'period_id'IS DISTINCT FROM c.period_id::text OR l.metadata->>'source_fingerprint'IS DISTINCT FROM c.source_fingerprint
 OR l.pre_from_balance-l.post_from_balance IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR l.post_to_balance-l.pre_to_balance IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed
 OR w.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.player_id OR w.type IS DISTINCT FROM'credit'OR w.amount IS DISTINCT FROM g.owed OR w.wallet_type IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN g.destination_kind='agent_wallet'THEN'BUSINESS'ELSE'PLAYER'END
 OR w.category IS DISTINCT FROM'rakeback'OR w.related_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM pp.id OR w.balance_after IS DISTINCT FROM l.post_to_balance
 OR(SELECT count(*)FROM public.settlement_invoices i WHERE i.source_ledger_id=l.id AND i.status='paid'AND i.chips_transferred AND i.message_sent AND i.net_amount=g.owed AND i.gross_amount=g.owed AND i.deductions=0)<>1));
EXCEPTION WHEN check_violation OR data_exception OR no_data_found THEN RETURN false;
END $function$
